paras_en: The yield on U.S. super‑long‑term Treasury bonds has not stayed at such high levels for a long time. As of Monday (31st), the 30‑year yield has been above 5% for 55 trading days, the longest streak since 2006, and the U.S. budget deficit, a new wave of corporate bond issuances, and the Fed—potentially a key turning point—make a decline in the coming weeks unlikely.
On Tuesday, the 30‑year Treasury yield was 5.27%. It had risen to 5.34% in mid‑August, the highest since 2007, just 10 basis points shy of the 22‑year high.

The yield is expected to keep rising. Even though Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced last month an expansion of Treasury bond buybacks to try to lower yields, many investors still do not expect a sustained reversal.

The Treasury’s buyback program may offset the corporate bond issuance wave; markets expect corporate issuances in September to reach $215 billion, and August corporate issuance already hit a record high. Moreover, few expect the U.S. fiscal problem to ease in the short term.

John Briggs, head of U.S. interest‑rate strategy at Natixis North America, said long‑term Treasury yields will stay high until the deficit structure changes, and called the Treasury’s bond‑buying scale “a drop in the bucket.”

Meanwhile, the Fed’s September meeting will test Chairman Kevin Warsh’s resolve to raise rates amid stubborn inflation. If the central bank hesitates, long‑term bonds are expected to face further selling.

Warsh’s hawkish remarks at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Summit last week led traders to anticipate a tightening of about 17 basis points at the September 15‑16 meeting, with a 70% chance of a rate hike. August employment data released Friday and September 11 inflation data will further gauge the extent of economic pressure.
Is the “long‑bond era” coming to an end? From the U.S. to Japan, governments now have to pay higher interest to attract investors to buy bonds and lend money to the state.

Because long‑term bonds are more sensitive to inflation concerns, if consumer price growth accelerates but the Fed stays idle, investors will have good reason to avoid the already troubled 30‑year bond.

Gregory Faranello, head of U.S. interest‑rate trading and strategy at AmeriVet Securities, said: “If you want long‑term yields to fall, you must raise rates.” He expects the Fed to hike and is bullish on the 10‑year Treasury and shorter‑dated bonds.

However, some investors bet that U.S. bonds will weaken further. Monday’s Treasury option trades show traders betting that the 30‑year yield will rise to about 5.7% by the November 20 contract expiry.
The 30‑year Treasury has a special status in the $31 trillion U.S. Treasury market.

Demand for long‑term Treasuries mainly comes from insurers and pension funds that need to match liabilities lasting decades. In contrast, portfolio managers who want to reduce duration sensitivity typically limit long‑dated positions.

Meghan Swiber and Eleanor Xiao of Bank of America’s rate strategy team wrote on Monday: “Despite Treasury buybacks and recent policy actions, investors still refuse to increase duration exposure. The shrinking official demand makes the market increasingly reliant on price‑sensitive private demand to absorb the growing Treasury supply.”

Wee Khoon Chong, head of overall strategy for Asia‑Pacific at BNY Mellon, said: “For duration and risk assets, the overall environment is becoming more challenging. Hawkish monetary policy, geopolitical and inflation risks resurface, and rising fiscal concerns are converging to keep pushing global term premiums and long‑term yields.”
Has the long bond fallen too far? Some investors question how much further the price can drop, as the 30‑year yield has risen about 65 basis points from its low this year.
Briggs of Natixis said he originally was bearish on long‑dated Treasuries, but at current levels his view has become “more neutral.”
He added that the 30‑year yield will “continue to rise gradually, but in terms of term premium and real yield it has already moved a long way and cannot keep rising at this pace forever.”
Priya Misra, portfolio manager at JPMorgan Asset Management, said Treasury buybacks may support long‑bond demand, but “the massive supply wave from AI infrastructure could far outstrip this support.”
She said: “We may be approaching the peak of long‑term yields, but given the various interacting factors, uncertainty remains.”
(This article is not open for collaboration.)

items.title: 戴爾今年狂飆265%還能漲？輝達、SpaceX成新推手
items.title_en: Dell’s 265% Surge This Year—Can It Keep Rising? Nvidia and SpaceX as New Drivers
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，一名分析師表示，AI領域幾項受到高度關注的重大交易，可能讓戴爾科技(Dell Technologies)(DELL-US)股價迎來更大漲幅。
首先，輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)近期宣布一項規模達5,000億美元的融資平台，將結合第三方資金，為先進AI實驗室及其他主要業者提供資金。瑞穗證券分析師Vijay Rakesh在近期給客戶的報告中表示，這項計畫對戴爾而言看來是正面消息。
他補充，即使實際金額只有上述規模的一小部分，也可能帶來對AI基礎建設「可觀的需求」。
戴爾生產資料中心伺服器，內含CPU。目前市場對這類產品的需求很高，主要用來支援代理型AI以及AI推論工作負載。戴爾也生產針對改善AI的伺服器，可支援輝達的GPU等AI晶片。
而SpaceX(SPCX-US)計劃在明年底前部署最多10GW的運算能力。Rakesh認為這項目標「可能過於樂觀」，但即使SpaceX實際部署約7GW的系統，也可能在2027年為戴爾帶來上漲空間。
他補充，7GW的部署規模可能代表超過2,000億美元的輝達商機。SpaceX此前曾表示，將只向輝達採購晶片。輝達與戴爾目前合作生產企業級伺服器與機架，供AI訓練及推論使用。Rakesh指出，SpaceX在資料中心上的資本支出可能超過亞馬遜及Google。
這些發展可能進一步成為戴爾股價的助力，而戴爾今年的表現本來就已經優於市場上一些最熱門的AI股票。
戴爾股價周一(8/31)小幅下跌，今年卻已大漲265.6%。漲幅甚至超過美光(Micron Technology)(MU-US)今年229.3%的漲幅。美光的業務受惠於AI熱潮帶動記憶體晶片需求大增。
戴爾今年也跑贏希捷科技(Seagate Technology)及威騰電子(Western Digital)。兩家公司今年分別上漲197%及159%。這些儲存設備供應商已成為AI資料中心建設的主要受益者。
同時，另一家伺服器製造商美超微電腦(Super Micro Computer)本月稍早公布的業績展望也讓華爾街留下深刻印象。該公司對營收及毛利率的預測均優於市場預期。Rakesh表示，這對戴爾而言也是正面訊號。
戴爾預計在周二美股收盤後公布財報。
Evercore ISI分析師Amit Daryanani表示，自戴爾上次公布財報以來，市場對該公司股票的討論焦點已經改變。當時投資人還在思考AI基礎建設需求究竟有多真實，如今關心的問題則變成「戴爾到底能出貨多少產品？」
Daryanani補充，戴爾在上次財報中表示，AI積壓訂單已創下513億美元的紀錄。若不是受到供應短缺限制，這些訂單將能讓公司實現更多成長潛力。
他也向客戶指出，AI雲端服務商CoreWeave及SpaceX近期大幅提高資本支出的計畫與相關說法值得注意。他稱這兩家公司是戴爾「最大的兩個客戶」。
Daryanani表示，在整個AI基礎建設領域，「限制因素正在擴大，而不是緩解」，並預期這種情況到了2027年還會更嚴重。
Daryanani同時預期，戴爾的儲存設備業務及客戶解決方案部門也將有強勁表現。後者包括個人電腦(PC)業務。
根據FactSet彙整的分析師預估，市場預期戴爾截至7月一季營收將達449億美元。市場共識預期，戴爾第二季調整後每股盈餘(EPS)將達4.92美元，較去年同期成長112%。
該公司的伺服器與網路設備部門營收預計將較去年同期成長近95%，達252億美元。
至於10月一季，根據FactSet的市場共識預估，華爾街預期戴爾調整後EPS為4.47美元，總營收則為414億美元。
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that an analyst believes several high-profile AI deals could further boost Dell Technologies’ (DELL-US) stock price.

First, Nvidia (NVDA-US) recently announced a $500 billion financing platform that will combine third‑party capital to fund advanced AI labs and other major players. Mizuho Securities analyst Vijay Rakesh said this plan is positive news for Dell.
He added that even a fraction of that amount could generate significant demand for AI infrastructure.

Dell manufactures data‑center servers that include CPUs. Demand for these products is high, mainly to support agent‑based AI and AI inference workloads. Dell also produces AI‑optimized servers that can support Nvidia GPUs and other AI chips.

SpaceX (SPCX-US) plans to deploy up to 10 GW of computing power by the end of next year. Rakesh thinks that target may be overly optimistic, but even a 7 GW deployment could create upside for Dell in 2027.

He added that a 7 GW deployment could represent more than $200 billion in Nvidia business. SpaceX has said it will only purchase chips from Nvidia. Nvidia and Dell currently collaborate on enterprise‑grade servers and racks for AI training and inference. Rakesh noted that SpaceX’s data‑center capital spend could exceed Amazon and Google.
These developments could further support Dell’s share price, and Dell has already outperformed some of the market’s hottest AI stocks this year.

Dell’s stock dipped slightly on Monday (8/31), but it has already risen 265.6% this year, even surpassing Micron Technology (MU-US)’s 229.3% gain. Micron’s business benefits from the AI boom driving a surge in memory‑chip demand.

Dell has also outpaced Seagate Technology and Western Digital, which rose 197% and 159% respectively this year. These storage‑equipment suppliers have become major beneficiaries of AI data‑center construction.

Meanwhile, another server maker, Super Micro Computer, impressed Wall Street with its early‑month earnings outlook, forecasting revenue and gross margin above expectations. Rakesh said this is also positive for Dell.
Dell is expected to release its earnings after the market close on Tuesday.

Evercore ISI analyst Amit Daryanani said that since Dell’s last earnings release, the focus of discussion around the stock has shifted. Investors were once questioning the reality of AI infrastructure demand, but now the question is how many products Dell can actually ship.
Daryanani added that Dell’s AI backlog hit a record $51.3 billion in the last report. If supply constraints were not an issue, these orders could unlock more growth potential for the company.
He also pointed out that the recent capital‑spending plans and statements from AI cloud provider CoreWeave and SpaceX are noteworthy. He said these two companies are Dell’s “biggest two customers.”
Daryanani said that in the entire AI infrastructure space, constraints are expanding rather than easing, and he expects the situation to worsen by 2027.
He also expects Dell’s storage‑equipment business and customer‑solutions division, which includes the PC business, to perform strongly.

According to FactSet‑compiled analyst estimates, the market expects Dell’s revenue for the July quarter to reach $44.9 billion. Consensus estimates that Dell’s adjusted EPS for Q2 will be $4.92, a 112% year‑over‑year increase.
The company’s server and networking revenue is expected to grow nearly 95% year‑over‑year to $25.2 billion.
For the October quarter, FactSet consensus estimates that Dell’s adjusted EPS will be $4.47 and total revenue $41.4 billion.

items.title: 百億美元帳面收益灌進財報 華爾街對AI浮盈大敲警鐘
items.title_en: Billions of Dollar Book‑Profit Pumped Into Earnings: Wall Street Sounds Alarm on AI Gains
paras: 美國大型科技企業最新一季獲利表面上持續強勁，但部分企業的稅前利潤正受到AI相關股權投資估值大幅上升的推動，引發市場對「盈利質量」的關注。最新數據顯示，Alphabet (GOOG-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、輝達(NVDA-US)及微軟(MSFT-US)等科技巨頭，近期業績中的「其他收入」大幅增加，其中相當部分來自持有其他AI企業的股權估值上升，屬於尚未實現的帳面收益，而非核心業務產生的現金流。
Alphabet截至6月30日的季度營業收入為1197.96億美元, 年增24%; 營業利潤407.70億美元, 年增30%。但公司當季「其他收入」淨額高達979.83億美元, 推動稅前利潤升至1387.53億美元, 意味著其他收入約占當季稅前利潤71%。
亞馬遜的情況同樣受到外部股權估值影響。公司第二季淨銷售額達2006.06億美元, 年增20%; 營業利潤274.61億美元, 年增43%。但其他收入淨額達534.15億美元, 主要來自對AI公司Anthropic的投資, 推動稅前利潤達808.57億美元, 其他收入約占稅前利潤66%。
亞馬遜官方財報也證實, 第二季淨利潤達626億美元, 遠高於2025年同期的182億美元, 其中包括535億美元非營運稅前其他收入, 主要來自Anthropic投資。與此同時, 公司過去12個月營業現金流增至1614億美元, 年增33%, 但自由現金流轉為76億美元流出, 主因AI相關資本支出大幅增加。
相較之下, 輝達與微軟的「其他收入」占比明顯較低。輝達截至7月26日的財季營收為962.21億美元, 營業利潤637.34億美元, 其他收入77.73億美元, 稅前利潤715.07億美元, 其他收入約占稅前利潤11%。
輝達的核心業務獲利仍然非常強勁。公司近期公布的財測也顯示AI晶片需求持續旺盛, 預期2027年營收增幅可達70%, 明顯高於市場原先預期的40%, 帶動股價單日大漲8.7%。不過, 公司同時警告記憶體元件可能出現供應短缺。
微軟截至6月30日的財季營收為900.07億美元, 營業利潤406.03億美元, 年增18%; 其他收入淨額34.44億美元, 稅前利潤440.47億美元, 其他收入占比不到8%。因此, 相較Alphabet及亞馬遜, 輝達與微軟的獲利對股權估值變動依賴程度相對有限。
目前市場關注的核心在於, 這些「其他收入」究竟來自何處。分析顯示, 主要有兩條來源, 第一是大型科技公司對OpenAI及Anthropic等AI企業的股權投資, 第二則是SpaceX上市後帶來的持股重估。
OpenAI與Anthropic近幾季估值快速上升, 使持有相關股權的科技企業能夠在財報中確認可觀的估值收益。亞馬遜對Anthropic的投資便是最明顯案例, 公司第二季535億美元非營運稅前其他收入主要來自該項投資。
SpaceX則成為另一項重要催化劑。SpaceX今年6月完成IPO, 發行約6.389億股A類普通股, 每股IPO價格135美元, 扣除承銷及相關成本後取得約856.75億美元淨募資。上市前, SpaceX已將馬斯克旗下xAI納入公司架構, 並將AI與太空基礎設施結合成為其資本市場故事的重要部分。
SpaceX上市後, 主要股東持股價值隨股價波動而重新計量。Alphabet及輝達均持有SpaceX股份, 因而可能透過股權估值變化影響財報中的其他收入。近期監管文件顯示, 輝達截至6月底持有約1.228億股SpaceX股份, 持股價值接近210億美元; Alphabet則持有約5.51億股, 價值約770億美元。
輝達持有SpaceX股份的背景與xAI有直接關聯。輝達此前投資馬斯克旗下xAI, 而xAI在SpaceX上市前被納入SpaceX, 使輝達最終取得SpaceX股權。這也意味著SpaceX上市及後續股價變化, 將成為輝達投資收益及其他收入的重要變數之一。
按照現行美國會計準則, 企業持有的部分股權投資需要按照公允價值計量, 估值變化可以直接反映在當期損益中。對於沒有公開市場報價的非上市股權, 則可採用「計量替代法」, 通常只有在出現可觀察交易價格, 例如新一輪融資定價時才進行重新估值。
這也解釋了為何AI股權投資收益有時會呈現「塊狀」出現。非上市AI企業通常只有在完成新一輪融資或出現其他可觀察交易時才重新估值; 一旦估值大幅提高, 持股企業便可能在單一季度確認巨額帳面收益。至於已上市的SpaceX, 則可以隨公開市場價格變化而重新計量。
值得注意的是, 這些收益本質上是估值變動產生的帳面利潤, 並不代表企業收到等額現金, 也不是由雲端服務、廣告、軟體或晶片銷售等核心業務直接創造的營業收入。因此, 如果相關AI企業未來估值下滑, 或者下一輪融資價格低於先前估值, 相關股權也可能出現帳面損失。
這種現象已經引起華爾街策略師及大型資產管理機構注意。路透旗下Breakingviews近期指出, SpaceX與Anthropic本身仍處於巨額投資階段, 卻透過其投資者的帳面收益對標普500企業獲利增長產生重大影響, 顯示AI產業的資本、股權及獲利之間已形成高度循環的關係。
高盛美股首席策略師Ben Snider表示, 投資人數年前便開始關注大型科技企業之間可能形成的循環效應, 核心問題是這些企業公布的獲利增長究竟反映真實市場需求, 還是部分受到企業彼此投資及估值提升的影響。
法國興業銀行美股策略主管Manish Kabra則認為, 大額股權投資收益讓市場開始重新思考「盈利質量」, 並指出相關疑慮已促使市場對這些公司的估值標準有所調整, 市盈率由約25倍降至約20倍。
北歐資產管理機構Nordea Asset Management固收與股票首席投資官Kasper Elmgreen也警告, 上半年業績可能高估了部分大型科技企業可持續的盈利能力, AI投資收益具有明顯的循環特徵, 因此需要對相關獲利保持警惕。
花旗美股策略師Scott Chronert則指出, 今年的大額一次性股權重估推高了科技企業的獲利基數。如果明年沒有相同規模的估值重估事件, 企業獲利成長可能反而轉為負值, 為後續財報帶來業績基數過高的風險。
Federated Hermes全球股票組合經理Louise Dudley則認為, 這些估值調整的規模已大到無法忽視, 確實增加額外風險。不過, 她也指出, 大型科技企業積極投資及與高成長AI企業合作, 本身仍具有一定戰略價值。
市場因此面臨一個關鍵問題: AI投資究竟是在創造真正的經濟價值, 還是在大型科技企業之間形成資金與估值互相推升的循環。近年大型科技企業一方面投入數千億美元建設AI資料中心、採購GPU及擴大雲端容量, 另一方面又透過股權投資取得AI新創企業的股份, 使資本支出與投資收益開始在同一產業鏈中相互交織。
這種現象並不代表大型科技企業的核心業務已經失去增長動力。以亞馬遜為例, AWS第二季營收達422億美元, 年增37%, AWS營業利潤也由去年同期102億美元升至166億美元, 顯示AI需求確實正在轉化為雲端業務的實際收入及利潤。
輝達則更加直接地反映AI需求。公司近期財測顯示, 2027年營收增長預期達70%, 遠高於市場原本約40%的共識, 顯示AI加速器需求仍然強勁。因此, 對投資人而言, 真正需要區分的並非「AI獲利是真是假」, 而是哪些獲利來自主營業務, 哪些則來自投資組合估值上升。
分析師普遍認為, 美國大型科技企業的基本面目前仍相對穩健, 但AI投資收益的不規則出現, 正讓財報解讀變得更加複雜。當OpenAI、Anthropic及SpaceX等AI相關企業估值持續上升時, 其股東可能獲得巨額帳面收益; 一旦估值週期反轉, 同一機制也可能反過來拖累科技巨頭的獲利。
因此, 市場接下來除了關注營收、營業利潤及自由現金流等傳統指標外, 也將更加重視「其他收入」的來源及可持續性。對大型科技企業而言, AI投資是否能最終轉化為可持續的產品收入、雲端營收及現金流, 將比單季出現多少帳面浮盈更能決定AI熱潮究竟具備多少真實成色。
paras_en: The latest quarter’s earnings of U.S. tech giants appear strong on the surface, but the pre‑tax profits of some firms are being driven by sharp rises in the valuation of AI equity investments, raising concerns about the quality of earnings. Recent data show that Alphabet (GOOG‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and Microsoft (MSFT‑US) have all seen a large increase in “other income” in their recent results, much of which comes from the appreciation of equity in other AI companies and represents unrealised book gains rather than cash flow from core operations.

Alphabet’s quarterly revenue as of June 30 was $119.796 billion, up 24% year‑over‑year; operating profit was $40.77 billion, up 30%. However, the company’s net “other income” reached $97.983 billion, lifting pre‑tax profit to $138.753 billion, meaning other income accounted for about 71% of pre‑tax profit that quarter.

Amazon’s situation is similarly affected by external equity valuation. The company’s second‑quarter net sales were $200.606 billion, up 20%; operating profit was $27.461 billion, up 43%. Net other income reached $53.415 billion, largely from its investment in AI company Anthropic, pushing pre‑tax profit to $80.857 billion, with other income making up about 66% of pre‑tax profit.

Amazon’s official earnings confirm that second‑quarter net profit was $62.6 billion, far above the $18.2 billion for the same period in 2025, including $53.5 billion of non‑operating pre‑tax other income mainly from the Anthropic investment. Meanwhile, operating cash flow for the past 12 months rose to $161.4 billion, up 33%, but free cash flow turned into an outflow of $7.6 billion, mainly due to a sharp increase in AI‑related capital expenditures.

In contrast, Nvidia and Microsoft’s “other income” ratios are much lower. Nvidia’s revenue for the fiscal quarter ending July 26 was $96.221 billion, operating profit $63.734 billion, other income $7.773 billion, pre‑tax profit $71.507 billion, with other income representing about 11% of pre‑tax profit.

Nvidia’s core business remains very strong. The company’s recent guidance shows that demand for AI chips remains robust, with revenue growth expected to reach 70% in 2027, well above the market’s original 40% forecast, driving the share price up 8.7% in a single day. However, the company also warned that memory components could face supply shortages.

Microsoft’s fiscal quarter ending June 30 had revenue of $90.007 billion, operating profit $40.603 billion, up 18%; net other income was $3.444 billion, pre‑tax profit $44.047 billion, with other income accounting for less than 8%. Thus, compared with Alphabet and Amazon, Nvidia and Microsoft’s earnings are relatively less dependent on equity valuation changes.

The current market focus is on where these “other income” items come from. Analysis shows two main sources: first, large tech companies’ equity investments in AI firms such as OpenAI and Anthropic; second, the re‑valuation of holdings following SpaceX’s IPO.

OpenAI and Anthropic have seen rapid valuation increases in recent quarters, allowing tech firms holding equity to record substantial valuation gains in their financial statements. Amazon’s investment in Anthropic is the most obvious example, with $53.5 billion of non‑operating pre‑tax other income in the second quarter coming from that investment.

SpaceX has become another key catalyst. In June of this year, SpaceX completed its IPO, issuing about 638.9 million Class A common shares at $135 per share, raising roughly $85.675 billion in net proceeds after underwriting and related costs. Before the listing, SpaceX had already incorporated Musk’s xAI into its structure, combining AI and space infrastructure as a key part of its capital‑market story.

After SpaceX’s IPO, major shareholders’ holdings were re‑measured as share prices fluctuated. Alphabet and Nvidia both hold SpaceX shares, potentially affecting other income through equity valuation changes. Recent regulatory filings show that Nvidia held about 122.8 million SpaceX shares as of the end of June, valued near $21 billion; Alphabet held about 551 million shares, valued at roughly $77 billion.

Nvidia’s holding of SpaceX shares is directly linked to xAI. Nvidia previously invested in Musk’s xAI, which was incorporated into SpaceX before the IPO, allowing Nvidia to ultimately acquire SpaceX equity. This means that SpaceX’s listing and subsequent share price movements will become an important variable for Nvidia’s investment gains and other income.

Under current U.S. accounting standards, a portion of equity investments held by a company must be measured at fair value, with valuation changes directly reflected in the current period’s income statement. For non‑public equity without a market price, a “measurement‑alternative” method is used, typically only when an observable transaction price exists, such as a new financing round.

This explains why AI equity investment gains sometimes appear in “blocks.” Non‑public AI companies are usually only re‑valued when a new financing round or other observable transaction occurs; once the valuation jumps, the holding company may record a large book gain in a single quarter. For listed SpaceX, re‑measurement can occur with changes in the public market price.

It is important to note that these gains are essentially book profits from valuation changes, not cash received, and are not generated by core business operations such as cloud services, advertising, software or chip sales. Therefore, if the valuation of the relevant AI companies falls in the future, or if the next financing round is priced below the previous valuation, the equity could also suffer a book loss.

This phenomenon has attracted the attention of Wall Street strategists and large asset managers. Reuters Breakingviews recently pointed out that SpaceX and Anthropic are still in a massive investment phase, yet their investors’ book gains significantly influence the earnings growth of S&P 500 companies, showing a highly cyclical relationship between capital, equity and earnings in the AI industry.

Goldman Sachs U.S. equity strategist Ben Snider said that investors have been concerned for years about a potential cyclical effect among large tech firms, and the core question is whether the reported earnings growth reflects real market demand or is partly driven by inter‑company investments and valuation increases.

French investment bank Société Générale’s U.S. equity strategist Manish Kabra believes that large equity investment gains have led the market to rethink “earnings quality,” and that concerns have prompted a shift in valuation standards, with price‑to‑earnings ratios falling from about 25× to roughly 20×.

Nordea Asset Management’s fixed‑income and equity chief investment officer Kasper Elmgreen warned that first‑half earnings may overstate the sustainable profitability of some large tech firms, as AI investment gains exhibit clear cyclical characteristics, so earnings should be viewed with caution.

Citigroup U.S. equity strategist Scott Chronert noted that this year’s large one‑off equity re‑valuations have inflated the earnings base of tech firms. If next year does not see a similarly sized valuation re‑valuation event, earnings growth could turn negative, creating a risk of an overly high earnings base for future reports.

Federated Hermes global equity portfolio manager Louise Dudley said the scale of these valuation adjustments is too large to ignore, adding extra risk. However, she also noted that large tech firms’ active investment and collaboration with high‑growth AI companies still hold strategic value.

The market therefore faces a key question: is AI investment creating real economic value, or is it forming a cycle of capital and valuation that lifts each other among large tech firms? In recent years, large tech companies have invested billions of dollars in AI data centers, GPU procurement and cloud capacity expansion, while also acquiring stakes in AI startups, intertwining capital expenditures and investment returns within the same industry chain.

This phenomenon does not mean that large tech firms’ core businesses have lost growth momentum. For example, Amazon’s AWS second‑quarter revenue reached $42.2 billion, up 37%; AWS operating profit rose from $10.2 billion last year to $16.6 billion, showing that AI demand is indeed translating into actual cloud revenue and profit.

Nvidia more directly reflects AI demand. The company’s recent guidance shows that revenue growth for 2027 is expected to reach 70%, far above the market’s original consensus of about 40%, indicating that AI accelerator demand remains strong. Therefore, for investors, the real distinction is not whether AI earnings are real or not, but which earnings come from core operations and which come from portfolio valuation increases.

Analysts generally believe that the fundamentals of U.S. large tech firms remain relatively robust, but the irregular appearance of AI investment gains is making earnings interpretation more complex. When valuations of AI companies such as OpenAI, Anthropic and SpaceX continue to rise, shareholders may receive large book gains; if the valuation cycle reverses, the same mechanism could drag down the earnings of tech giants.

Thus, the market will pay more attention not only to traditional metrics such as revenue, operating profit and free cash flow, but also to the source and sustainability of “other income.” For large tech firms, whether AI investment ultimately translates into sustainable product revenue, cloud income and cash flow will determine the true substance of the AI boom more than the amount of book profit in any single quarter.

items.title: OpenAI、Anthropic也加入搶購潮 蘋果Mac mini成AI產業首選裝置
items.title_en: OpenAI and Anthropic Join the Rush; Apple Mac mini Becomes the AI Industry's First Choice Device
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 電腦Mac mini和Mac Studio在多個市場短缺，人工智慧（AI）蓬勃發展可能在其中扮演了意想不到的角色。
人工智慧開發者越來越多地使用Mac mini和Mac Studio來訓練人工智慧模型或運行人工智慧代理，其高性能M系列晶片、大容量記憶體和優於MacBook的散熱性，能使其在長時間處理複雜人工智慧任務方面具有優勢。
與租用昂貴GPU不同，直接購買這些設備還可以幫助企業降低雲端使用成本。據《The Information》報導，OpenAI已購買了數萬台Mac mini和Mac Studio，用於強化學習和訓練人工智慧代理。
Anthropic則通過亞馬遜雲端服務使用 Mac mini。各大人工智慧公司已開始運用蘋果的消費級個人電腦作為其人工智慧運算基礎設施的一部分。
與此同時，開發者和消費者也越來越傾向於使用蘋果緊湊型電腦在本地運行人工智慧，這一趨勢在中國尤其明顯。
在Openclaw剛開始流行之際，Mac mini就曾因出色運行性能和較低能耗被視為部署AI代理的最佳裝置，引發哄搶。
打造Mac專屬AI雲端平台的趨勢也正在興起。新創公司Mount Thor正在開發基於蘋果硬體的AI執行環境，該公司由一名前OpenAI運算基礎設施員工創立。
此外，開源軟體也已問世，它可以通過連接多台Mac電腦，在辦公室或實驗室中運行擁有兆個參數的AI模型。
paras_en: Apple's (AAPL-US) Mac mini and Mac Studio are experiencing shortages in several markets, and the booming artificial intelligence (AI) sector may be playing an unexpected role in this trend.

More and more AI developers are using the Mac mini and Mac Studio to train AI models or run AI agents, thanks to their high‑performance M‑series chips, large memory capacities, and superior cooling compared to the MacBook, giving them an edge in handling complex AI tasks for extended periods.

Unlike renting expensive GPUs, purchasing these devices outright can also help companies reduce cloud usage costs. According to The Information, OpenAI has bought tens of thousands of Mac minis and Mac Studios to bolster reinforcement learning and train AI agents.
Anthropic, meanwhile, is using Mac minis through Amazon Web Services. Major AI companies have begun incorporating Apple’s consumer‑grade personal computers into their AI computing infrastructure.
At the same time, developers and consumers are increasingly leaning toward running AI locally on Apple’s compact computers, a trend that is especially pronounced in China.
When Openclaw first gained popularity, the Mac mini was hailed as the best device for deploying AI agents due to its excellent performance and low power consumption, sparking a frenzy of purchases.

The trend of building Mac‑exclusive AI cloud platforms is also emerging. Startup Mount Thor is developing an AI execution environment based on Apple hardware, founded by a former OpenAI infrastructure engineer.
In addition, open‑source software has been released that can connect multiple Macs to run AI models with billions of parameters in offices or laboratories.

items.title: Anthropic陷「史上規模最大」智慧財產權竊盜之一！索尼、華納聯手起訴
paras: 人工智慧（AI）產業的版權戰火持續延燒。索尼音樂出版（Sony Music Publishing）、華納查普爾音樂及數十家關聯音樂出版公司，8月28日向美國加州北區聯邦地區法院提起訴訟，將AI新創Anthropic及其共同創辦人暨執行長阿莫迪（Dario Amodei）、共同創辦人Benjamin Mann列為被告。
音樂出版商指控，Anthropic早期曾透過BT下載、網頁抓取及第三方資料集等方式，大量取得受版權保護的音樂作品，並將歌詞、樂譜等內容納入Claude模型訓練。
原告形容相關行為是「歷史上規模最大、最公然且仍在持續的智慧財產竊盜之一」。
此次訴訟涉及「數萬首」音樂作品。若法院最終認定屬於故意侵權，依美國版權法，每部作品最高可能面臨15萬美元的法定賠償；若另涉及刪除或修改版權管理資訊，每項違法行為最高還可能面臨2.5萬美元法定賠償，理論上的賠償規模可能達數十億美元。
Anthropic則否認相關指控，公司發言人表示，將在法庭上積極為自身辯護。
這起案件對Anthropic而言尤其敏感。公司6月已確認向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）秘密遞交IPO申請文件。
根據《The Information》8月27日報導，Anthropic可能在美國勞動節後公開招股文件，最快於9月底至10月初上市。
就在不久前，Anthropic才完成650億美元融資，投後估值達9650億美元，並披露年化營收已超過470億美元。
同時，公司也剛處理另一宗大規模版權訴訟，作家集體訴訟案已在支付15億美元和解金的條件下獲法院最終批准。

從700多萬本盜版電子書開始

此次訴訟的一大關鍵，在於Anthropic早期取得訓練資料的方式。
2021年6月，也就是Anthropic成立不到半年後，共同創辦人Mann開始尋找能快速擴充模型訓練資料的方法，目標之一就是被出版業視為「影子圖書館」的Library Genesis（LibGen）。
根據先前訴訟中公開的法院資料，Mann代表Anthropic透過BT，從LibGen下載至少約500萬本電子書；2022年7月，Anthropic團隊又從另一個盜版資源庫Pirate Library Mirror（PiLiMi）取得至少約200萬本電子書。
在此前的Bartz v. Anthropic案件中，美國聯邦地區法官William Alsup認定相關電子書屬於盜版內容，並認為Anthropic的行為本質上是大規模的直接盜版。
這些資料原本是作家版權訴訟的重要爭議，如今則成為索尼與華納追查音樂作品來源的切入點。
兩家出版商指出，LibGen與PiLiMi收錄的不只有小說、教材和非虛構作品，也包含歌詞集、樂譜集及其他音樂出版品，因此包括《Livin’ on a Prayer》、《September》、《Great Balls of Fire》、《Ramblin’ Man》及《Hallelujah》等作品，都被列入訴狀所涉及的內容。
索尼與華納認為，與部分AI版權案件只能透過模型輸出推測訓練資料不同，本案已有先前訴訟留下的內部文件與司法紀錄，可以用來追溯Anthropic早期取得資料的過程。
訴狀也援引先前公開資料指出，Mann曾在公司內部形容LibGen「非常可疑」，Anthropic內部的Archive Team也曾將其描述為明顯侵犯版權的網站。
原告因此將阿莫迪與Mann一併列為被告，主張Mann曾親自參與早期資料下載，而阿莫迪則涉及資料集取得的審批。至於兩名創辦人是否需要承擔直接或協助侵權責任，仍須由法院審理。

網頁抓取、第三方資料集也成為攻防焦點

索尼與華納的指控並不僅限於盜版電子書。
根據訴狀，Claude使用的歌詞也可能來自公開網頁、Common Crawl等大型網路資料集，以及Books3、The Pile等第三方訓練資料集。
其中，音樂出版商特別點名Musixmatch與LyricFind。兩家公司透過授權模式向使用者提供歌詞，但原告認為，網站本身擁有歌詞展示授權，並不代表第三方可以大量複製這些內容，再用於商業AI模型訓練。
索尼與華納主張，Anthropic可能透過網路爬蟲或第三方資料集取得這些歌詞內容，而Common Crawl資料中也包含來自相關歌詞網站的頁面。
此外，先前Bartz案件也揭露，Mann早期取得Books3資料集中的196,640份未經授權電子書。Anthropic內部曾肯定Books3的資料品質，同時也討論其法律風險；The Pile則將Books3等不同來源整合進更大型的開放訓練資料集。
因此，原始資料即使來自盜版網站，也可能透過二手、三手資料集進入AI公司的訓練環境。
Anthropic甚至曾採取實體書籍數位化的方式擴充資料。法院資料顯示，公司約在2024年前後投入數百萬美元購買數百萬本紙本書，再由服務商拆除裝訂、切割書頁並逐頁掃描，轉換成可供機器讀取的PDF，之後丟棄紙本原件。這項計畫後來被稱為「Project Panama」。
不過，這種作法與從盜版網站下載電子書仍存在法律上的差異。Alsup此前認為，Anthropic若合法購買紙本書，再將其數位化並用於模型訓練，在相關案件中可以受到合理使用原則保護。
因此，索尼與華納此次試圖追問的是，Anthropic數位化的書籍是否包含受其控制的歌詞與樂譜，以及這些內容後續如何被保存、處理與使用。

合理使用並非所有資料取得行為的免責盾牌

Anthropic在先前的版權訴訟中曾取得對AI產業相當重要的裁決。
2025年6月，Alsup在Bartz案中認定，在該案特定情況下，Anthropic使用受版權保護的書籍訓練Claude，可以構成合理使用。法院認為，模型透過作品學習語言關係並產生新的內容，與直接向使用者提供原始書籍具有轉換性。
但法院同時劃出界線：模型訓練最終可能構成合理使用，並不代表企業可以合法從盜版來源取得作品。
Anthropic從LibGen等來源取得700多萬本盜版電子書，並長期保存於內部資料庫的行為，並未因此獲得合理使用保護。
這項判決也成為後續訴訟的重要基礎。Anthropic後來與作家集體訴訟達成15億美元和解，法院並於2026年7月20日最終批准協議。案件涉及482,460部符合條件的作品，符合條件的作者與出版商預計每部作品可獲得約3,000美元賠償。Anthropic並未在和解中承認違法。
索尼與華納如今試圖利用的，正是「訓練本身」與「取得資料」之間的法律區別。
兩家公司並未單純將訴訟集中在「利用歌詞訓練AI是否屬於合理使用」，而是將Anthropic的相關行為拆分為BT下載、網頁抓取、第三方資料集取得、訓練過程中的複製、模型輸出，以及版權管理資訊刪除等不同環節。
訴狀主要提出四類指控，包括BT下載構成直接侵權、阿莫迪與Mann涉及協助侵權、Anthropic自身直接侵犯版權，以及刪除或修改版權管理資訊。

版權管理資訊刪除也成為另一戰場

除了作品本身，原告還把矛頭指向版權管理資訊。
這類資訊通常包括作品名稱、詞曲作者、版權所有人及版權聲明等內容。索尼與華納指控，Anthropic在整理網頁資料時，可能使用能夠移除頁尾、版權所有人名稱及版權提示的工具。
原告據此主張，Anthropic在處理歌詞及其他訓練資料時，可能刪除或修改受到法律保護的版權管理資訊。
若法院認定Anthropic明知這些資訊受到法律保護，仍故意將其移除，案件可能進一步涉及美國《數位千禧年著作權法》（DMCA）關於版權管理資訊的規定。
不過，這部分指控同樣仍有待法院認定。出版商必須證明哪些具體資訊遭到刪除，以及Anthropic在刪除時是否具備法律所要求的主觀認知，並進一步證明相關行為與侵權存在關聯。
換言之，資料清理工具本身能夠移除網頁頁尾，並不當然代表構成違法；真正的法律爭點，在於被移除的內容是否屬於受保護的版權管理資訊，以及Anthropic是否明知其性質。

三大音樂集團陸續加入Anthropic版權戰

事實上，音樂產業與Claude之間的版權衝突已持續近3年。
2023年10月，環球音樂出版集團（Universal Music Publishing Group）、Concord Music Group與ABKCO率先起訴Anthropic，指控Claude使用並輸出約500首受版權保護歌曲的歌詞。
2025年1月，雙方就部分爭議達成安排，Anthropic同意維持並強化Claude的版權保護措施，限制模型直接向使用者輸出受保護歌詞，相關限制也必須延續至未來版本。
但訴訟並未因此結束。
2026年1月，環球音樂出版、Concord與ABKCO再次提起更大規模訴訟，涉及超過2萬首作品，求償金額超過30億美元。
3月，Bertelsmann旗下BMG Rights Management再針對493部音樂作品提出訴訟；8月17日，Round Hill Music也對Anthropic提告，並表示隨著涉案作品增加，潛在賠償可能達數億美元。
隨著索尼與華納加入，全球三大音樂集團的出版業務如今都已分別捲入針對Anthropic的版權訴訟。
索尼與華納同時指控，Claude現有的歌詞保護機制可能透過修改提問方式、重複提示等方式被繞過。不過，模型保護措施究竟是否容易遭到規避、Anthropic是否刻意訓練模型複製歌詞，以及具體哪些作品構成侵權，目前均屬原告主張，尚未經法院認定。
Anthropic也已開始反擊。公司8月在環球音樂出版等機構提起的第二起案件中，申請駁回部分訴求；阿莫迪則另外要求法院撤銷針對其個人提出的直接侵權指控。

音樂產業一手提告、一手擁抱授權AI

值得注意的是，音樂產業並非全面反對AI使用音樂作品。隨著版權訴訟增加，部分音樂公司也開始與AI業者建立授權合作。
2025年11月，華納音樂集團與AI音樂公司Suno結束此前的版權訴訟，並達成下一代AI音樂模型授權合作，Suno承諾推出使用產業授權內容的新模型。
今年8月12日，BMG也與Suno達成全球策略合作，涵蓋BMG旗下錄音及音樂出版曲庫，參與的藝人與詞曲作者可以選擇是否加入並取得報酬，雙方也將處理Suno此前使用BMG作品所衍生的問題。
就在索尼與華納提告Anthropic前3天，8月25日，索尼音樂集團、環球音樂集團與華納音樂集團共同參與Stability AI的7,600萬美元B輪融資。Stability AI則強調，其Stable Audio 3.0音樂模型使用「完全獲得授權的資料」。
對音樂產業而言，投資AI公司與對另一家AI公司提起版權訴訟並不矛盾。兩者反映的其實是不同的商業模式：一種建立在授權、報酬與權利人選擇權之上；另一種則必須面對訓練資料來源是否經過合法取得的司法審查。

Anthropic面臨的不只是賠償風險

索尼與華納此次向法院提出的要求，也不只是金錢賠償。
兩家公司要求Anthropic揭露Claude所使用的訓練資料、訓練方式，以及取得與處理受版權保護作品的方法，同時要求銷毀公司控制範圍內的侵權副本。
對Anthropic而言，這起訴訟的時間點也使風險更加受到市場關注。
隨著公司可能進入IPO流程，重大訴訟、潛在賠償責任及相關合規風險，都可能成為投資人評估公司的重要資訊。市場也可能進一步關注Anthropic能否說明訓練資料來源、資料取得是否合法，以及還有多少作品可能引發類似索賠。
如果法院未來要求銷毀部分資料，爭議甚至可能延伸至已完成訓練的模型，包括模型參數是否需要重新訓練、刪除原始資料能否消除侵權影響，以及不同Claude版本究竟使用哪些資料。
從作家、音樂出版商接連提起的訴訟來看，AI版權爭議的核心正在逐漸從單純的「AI訓練是否屬於合理使用」，擴大至「資料從何而來、如何取得、如何保存、如何處理，以及最終如何進入模型」。
對Anthropic而言，訓練資料已不只是打造AI模型的原料，也成為必須向法院及潛在投資人說明來源與法律風險的重要資產。

items.title: 日經一度重挫逾700點後收斂至跌0.15%，資金從AI半導體轉向金融價值股
items.title_en: Nikkei Rebounds After Slipping Over 700 Points to End Down 0.15%, Funds Shift From AI Semiconductors to Financial Value Stocks
paras: 2026年09月01日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 日本股市週二震盪，受到美伊衝突推升油價，以及美日長期利率同步走高影響，日經225指數早盤一度重挫超過700點，終場跌幅收斂至0.15%，下跌96.59點至66,215.34點；東證股價指數(TOPIX)則逆勢上漲0.62%至4,181.86點，連續第9個交易日走高。
美國對伊朗發動軍事攻擊後，市場擔憂能源運輸受阻可能推高通膨，帶動原油價格及美國長期公債殖利率上升。日本長期利率盤中也一度突破3%，為約30年來首見，高估值AI與半導體股因此面臨較明顯賣壓。
半導體族群中，東京威力科創Tokyo Electron(8035-JP)、愛德萬測試Advantest(6857-JP)、Disco(6146-JP)及Lasertec(6920-JP)走弱；記憶體業者鎧俠Kioxia(285A-JP)則逆勢上漲2.02%，軟銀集團SoftBank Group(9984-JP)上漲1.19%。
不過，日經指數盤中快速收復大部分跌幅。南韓股市走高帶動海外資金回補日經期貨，加上日經225指數25日均線約65,700點形成支撐，企業獲利成長預期也吸引逢低買盤。
資金輪動是當日盤面的另一項重點。隨日本利率上升，部分資金從AI與半導體等高估值成長股轉向銀行、商社及汽車等價值股，帶動TOPIX逼近8月14日創下的4,197.20點歷史高點。豐田汽車Toyota Motor(7203-JP)上漲2.76%，三菱日聯金融集團MUFG(8306-JP)上漲0.54%。
東京證交所Prime市場成交金額約7.5兆日圓，上漲家數845家，高於下跌的662家，另有49家持平。日經指數雖收黑，但TOPIX連續9日上漲及上漲家數占多數，顯示日本股市目前更接近利率上升帶動的類股重新定價，而非全面性資金撤出。

paras_en: On Tuesday, September 1, 2026, Japan's stock market wavered. Fueled by higher oil prices after the US‑Iran clash and a simultaneous rise in US and Japanese long‑term rates, the Nikkei 225 plunged more than 700 points in early trading but narrowed its loss to 0.15% by the close, down 96.59 points to 66,215.34. The TOPIX, by contrast, rose 0.62% to 4,181.86, marking its ninth consecutive day of gains.

After the United States launched a military strike on Iran, markets feared that disrupted energy shipments could stoke inflation, pushing crude oil prices and US long‑term Treasury yields higher. Japan's long‑term rates briefly breached 3% intraday – a level not seen in roughly 30 years – putting pressure on high‑valuation AI and semiconductor stocks.

Within the semiconductor sector, Tokyo Electron (8035‑JP), Advantest (6857‑JP), Disco (6146‑JP) and Lasertec (6920‑JP) weakened, while memory‑chip maker Kioxia (285A‑JP) rose 2.02% against the trend and SoftBank Group (9984‑JP) gained 1.19%.

However, the Nikkei quickly recovered most of its losses during the session. A rally in South Korean equities attracted overseas capital back into Nikkei futures, and the index found support around its 25‑day moving average near 65,700 points, while earnings‑growth expectations drew value‑seeking buyers.

Capital rotation was another key theme of the day. As Japanese rates climbed, some investors moved from high‑valuation growth names in AI and semiconductors to value stocks such as banks, trading houses and automakers, pushing the TOPIX toward the August 14 record high of 4,197.20 points. Toyota Motor (7203‑JP) rose 2.76% and MUFG (8306‑JP) gained 0.54%.

Trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime market totaled about ¥7.5 trillion, with 845 stocks advancing, 662 declining and 49 unchanged. Although the Nikkei closed in the red, the TOPIX’s nine‑day winning streak and the predominance of advancing stocks suggest the market is now more about sector re‑pricing driven by rising rates than a broad‑scale capital outflow.

items.title: 記憶體漲不停 DRAM、NAND將吃掉雲端巨頭68%資本支出
items.title_en: Memory Prices Keep Rising: DRAM and NAND Set to Consume 68% of Cloud Giants' Capital Expenditure
paras: 集邦諮詢（TrendForce）最新研究顯示，全球大型雲端服務供應商（CSP）正加速投資 AI 基礎設施，2026 年資本支出預估年增 98%，2027 年還將在此基礎上再成長 50%。隨著記憶體價格持續攀升，DRAM 與 NAND 快閃記憶體合計占資本支出的比重，將從 2026 年的 47%進一步升至 2027 年的 68%。
自 2025 年下半年以來，記憶體合約價大幅上漲，明顯推高相關採購支出。伺服器 DRAM 合約價在 2025 年下半年累計上漲 64%，預估 2026 年將再大漲約 270%；NAND 市場也呈現相同趨勢，企業級固態硬碟（SSD）價格在 2025 年下半年上漲約 35%，2026 年累計漲幅預估將達 235%。
儘管部分自 2026 年第二季起簽署的長期協議（LTA）已設定價格上限，可能限制後續漲價空間，但 2027 年高頻寬記憶體（HBM）合約價仍預估上漲 70%至 140%。集邦諮詢認為，2027 年整體記憶體合約價仍將維持高檔，持續推升其占雲端服務商資本支出的比重。
除了價格上漲，雲端服務商對記憶體位元的需求也快速成長，促使廠商將有限產能優先配置給伺服器應用。集邦諮詢估算，2026 年 HBM 與暫存器雙列直插記憶體模組（RDIMM），合計將占 DRAM 位元供應量的 51%。
到了 2027 年下半年，隨著製程升級及新建晶圓廠產能逐步提升，伺服器 DRAM 與 HBM 的位元總供應量預計成長 27%。合約價持續上揚，尤其是 HBM 漲幅居高不下，再加上位元供應量增加，將共同推動記憶體支出占大型雲端服務商資本支出的比重升至 68%。
記憶體成本高漲，也為輝達等伺服器及 AI 晶片業者調高價格提供更多理由。大型雲端服務商若要維持原定的 AI 晶片採購規模，可能需要進一步增加資本支出。
另一種做法則是降低單一系統的記憶體容量，更積極調整 AI 系統架構，在維持 AI 晶片與伺服器出貨目標的同時，緩解 DRAM、NAND 價格高漲及供應配額受限的壓力。可能採取的方式包括調整 RDIMM 配置、縮減下一代 AI 晶片整合的 HBM 容量，以及研發將模型架構固化於晶片中的 AI 專用積體電路（ASIC）。
paras_en: TrendForce’s latest research shows that global large cloud service providers (CSPs) are accelerating investment in AI infrastructure, with capital expenditures projected to grow 98% year‑over‑year in 2026 and to increase another 50% in 2027. As memory prices continue to climb, the combined share of DRAM and NAND flash in capex will rise from 47% in 2026 to 68% in 2027.

Since the second half of 2025, memory contract prices have surged sharply, clearly pushing up related procurement costs. Server DRAM contract prices rose 64% cumulatively in H2 2025, and are expected to jump another roughly 270% in 2026; the NAND market shows the same trend, with enterprise‑grade SSD prices up about 35% in H2 2025 and an estimated cumulative increase of 235% in 2026.

Although some long‑term agreements (LTAs) signed from Q2 2026 onward have set price caps that may limit further hikes, the 2027 contract price for high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) is still forecast to rise between 70% and 140%. TrendForce believes that overall memory contract prices will remain high in 2027, continuing to lift their share of cloud providers’ capex.

Beyond price increases, cloud providers’ demand for memory bits is also growing rapidly, prompting manufacturers to prioritize limited capacity for server applications. TrendForce estimates that in 2026, HBM and registered‑DIMM (RDIMM) modules together will account for 51% of the DRAM bit supply.

By the second half of 2027, as process upgrades and new fab capacity come online, the total bit supply of server DRAM and HBM is expected to grow 27%. Contract prices will keep rising—especially HBM, whose price gains remain strong—and the added supply will together push memory spending to represent 68% of large cloud providers’ capital expenditures.

The soaring memory costs also give companies like Nvidia and other server and AI‑chip makers more justification to raise their prices. Large cloud providers may need to further increase capex if they want to maintain their planned AI‑chip procurement volumes.

Another approach is to reduce the memory capacity per system and more aggressively re‑architect AI workloads, thereby easing pressure from high DRAM and NAND prices and constrained supply while still meeting AI‑chip and server shipment targets. Possible measures include adjusting RDIMM configurations, cutting the HBM capacity integrated into next‑generation AI chips, and developing AI‑specific ASICs that hard‑wire model architectures onto the chip.

items.title: 幾小時工作3分鐘搞定 Grok Bot被封「下一個ChatGPT時刻」
items.title_en: Hours of Work, 3 Minutes to Finish: Grok Bot Gets Banned as the 'Next ChatGPT Moment'
paras: 矽谷頂尖投資人、投資機構 Atreides 創辦人 Gavin Baker 近日在 a16z 對談節目中直言，Grok Bot 可能代表「另一個 ChatGPT 時刻」。他指出，自己原本花費數小時利用 Claude Code 打造一套工具流程，Grok Bot 卻只用約 3 分鐘便完成效果更好的版本，顯示 AI Agent 正從輔助工具加速轉向能主動完成工作的執行者。
Baker 表示，無論是整理 Podcast、摘要 Substack 文章，或追蹤 X 平台上的市場情緒，過去透過 Claude Code 處理每項任務，都得花上數小時設定與調整；換成 Grok Bot 後，單項任務僅需 7 至 12 秒，產出品質也更勝原先版本。
價格下降進一步推升 Grok Bot 的吸引力。這款應用過去曾因每月收費 200 美元遭批價格過高，近期月費大幅降至 20 美元，並納入 Cursor Pro 與 Super Grok 訂閱方案，明顯降低使用門檻。
馬斯克也在社群平台轉發相關討論。有使用者分享，透過另一款熱門 Agent「Instinct」與 Stripe Link，已能在聊天介面中替姪女完成購買鋼琴的整套流程。馬斯克則宣稱，Grok Bot 更勝一籌，不僅可以協助購物，還能主動搜尋並議價，找出最優惠的價格。
不只是換殼聊天機器人
Grok Bot 與傳統聊天機器人的最大差異，在於它不是單純回答問題，而是能登入不同軟體、使用獨立雲端電腦，並持續執行工作的 AI Agent。
在 Grok Bot 出現前，Hermes、OpenClaw 等 Agent 工具雖然功能強大，但使用者仍須選擇模型、設定上下文視窗與思考深度，並配置 API 金鑰，繁複流程讓多數一般使用者難以上手。Grok Bot 則採取極簡設計，不必自行挑選模型或工具，只要建立新 Bot 並開始對話，系統便會自動配置適合的方案。
透過現場操作示範，Grok Bot 還能學習使用者的工作流程。使用者只要帶著 Bot 完整執行一次跨步驟、跨系統的任務，它便能將流程保存為固定例程，之後依照排程或需求重新執行。
每個Bot都有獨立雲端電腦
Grok Bot 的另一項核心設計，是以雲端電腦為優先。每個新建立的 Bot，都擁有獨立的 Chrome 瀏覽器、檔案系統與終端機，即使使用者關閉筆電，Bot 仍可在雲端持續運作。
命名後的 Bot 也能在多輪對話中保留記憶、檔案、瀏覽器工作階段與偏好設定，使上下文持續累積，而不是每次接到任務都回到全新環境。
在權限管理方面，使用者不必直接把主要帳號及密碼交給 AI，而是可透過專供 Agent 使用的電子郵件，像邀請新進員工一樣，將 Bot 加入指定專案、社群或工具，並只開放必要權限。
多個Agent組成工作團隊
Grok Bot 也強調多 Agent 協作。不同 Bot 預設可以互相傳送訊息，使用者可建立一個類似「CEO」的主 Bot，再由它拆解任務，分派給研究、程式設計及視覺設計等專業 Bot。
這些 Bot 能在背景交換資訊、檢視彼此成果並完成交付，使用者不再只是與單一對話框互動，而是指揮一個由多個 AI Agent 組成的工作團隊。
Baker 認為，Claude Code 在程式碼生成方面確實帶來重大突破，但本質上仍屬於「下指令、給回應」的 Copilot 模式。Claude Code 與 Codex 雖能強化知識與效率，仍偏向收到需求後才展開工作的反應式工具。
在他看來，足以稱為「ChatGPT 級顛覆」的產品必須具備兩項條件：首先是使用門檻大幅下降，將原本耗費數小時的工作縮短至十幾秒；其次是效率提升後，產出品質不但沒有下滑，反而更好。
Grok Bot 正跨越這道門檻，從協助使用者工作的工具，轉變為能主動完成任務的自動執行者。它不僅能快速建立工具，也可藉由觀察日常操作，主動提出自動化建議。
AI用量可能迎來爆發
Baker 看好的商業邏輯也建立在這項轉變之上。過去一問一答的互動模式，算力與 Token 消耗仍有上限；一旦 AI 開始接管完整工作流程，使用者只需按下同意執行，Agent 就能在後台持續處理任務，Token 使用量可能隨之大幅成長。
他所說的「下一個 ChatGPT 時刻」，正是從使用門檻驟降、產出品質提升，進一步走向主動推薦行動；當使用者授權執行後，AI 使用量也將快速擴張。Grok Bot 因此不只是另一款效率工具，而可能代表 AI 應用模式的轉變。
打造個人AI工作團隊
對於如何使用 Grok Bot，部分使用者建議先建立一個名為「幕僚長」或「CEO」的主 Bot，並將其置頂，作為所有任務的單一對接窗口，再由它決定如何把工作分派給其他專業 Bot。
接著，使用者可以向主 Bot 說明自己的身分、公司業務、工作痛點、最不想處理的日常事項，以及短期與長期目標。待這些資訊輸入完成後，再要求它根據既有理解，建議需要建立哪些專業 Bot，規畫各自的角色、職責與運作流程，並直接完成建立。
透過 Grok Bot 的跨 Agent 調度與權限控制，主 Bot 可在短時間內產生一套具備名稱、頭像與系統提示詞的專屬 AI 團隊。從單一聊天視窗走向持續運作的多 Agent 系統，正是 Baker 將 Grok Bot 視為下一個「ChatGPT 時刻」的主要原因。
paras_en: Silicon Valley top investor and Atreides founder Gavin Baker recently stated on a16z's talk show that Grok Bot could represent "another ChatGPT moment." He noted that he had spent hours using Claude Code to build a tool workflow, while Grok Bot completed a better version in about three minutes, showing AI agents are shifting from assistive tools to proactive executors.

Baker said that whether it was organizing podcasts, summarizing Substack articles, or tracking market sentiment on X, each task used to take hours of setting and tweaking with Claude Code. With Grok Bot, a single task now takes only 7 to 12 seconds and produces higher quality results.

The price drop further boosts Grok Bot's appeal. The app was previously criticized for its $200 monthly fee, but the subscription has recently fallen to $20 and is now included in the Cursor Pro and Super Grok plans, clearly lowering the entry barrier.

Elon Musk also shared the discussion on social media. Users reported that with another popular agent, Instinct, and Stripe Link, they could complete the entire piano purchase process for a niece in a chat interface. Musk claimed Grok Bot is even better, not only assisting with shopping but also proactively searching, negotiating, and finding the best price.
Not just a rebranded chatbot

The biggest difference between Grok Bot and traditional chatbots is that it doesn't simply answer questions; it can log into different software, use independent cloud computers, and continuously execute tasks as an AI agent.

Before Grok Bot, agents like Hermes and OpenClaw were powerful but required users to choose models, set context windows and depth of thought, and configure API keys. The complex process made it difficult for most casual users to get started. Grok Bot adopts a minimalist design, eliminating the need to pick models or tools; just create a new bot and start chatting, and the system automatically configures the appropriate solution.

During a live demo, Grok Bot can also learn a user's workflow. If a user has the bot complete a multi-step, cross-system task once, it can save the process as a fixed routine and later re-execute it on schedule or as needed.
Each bot has its own cloud computer

Another core design of Grok Bot prioritizes cloud computers. Every newly created bot has its own Chrome browser, file system, and terminal, so even if the user turns off their laptop, the bot continues to run in the cloud.

Named bots can retain memory, files, browser sessions, and preferences across multiple turns of conversation, allowing context to accumulate rather than resetting to a fresh environment each time a task is received.

In terms of permission management, users do not need to hand over their main account and password to the AI. Instead, they can use an agent-specific email, inviting the bot to a designated project, community, or tool like onboarding a new employee, and grant only the necessary permissions.
Multiple agents form a work team

Grok Bot also emphasizes multi-agent collaboration. Different bots can send messages to each other by default; users can create a main bot, like a "CEO," which then breaks down tasks and delegates them to research, programming, and visual design bots.
These bots can exchange information in the background, review each other's results, and complete deliveries, so users no longer interact with a single chat window but command a team of AI agents.

Baker believes Claude Code has made significant breakthroughs in code generation, but it remains a "give command, receive response" Copilot model. Claude Code and Codex, while enhancing knowledge and efficiency, still lean toward reactive tools that start work only after receiving a request.

In his view, a product worthy of the "ChatGPT-level disruption" must meet two conditions: first, the barrier to entry must drop dramatically, reducing hours of work to a few seconds; second, the efficiency gains must not lower output quality, but rather improve it.

Grok Bot is crossing that threshold, moving from a tool that assists users to an autonomous executor that proactively completes tasks. It can not only quickly build tools but also observe daily operations and suggest automation proactively.
AI usage may explode

Baker's optimistic business logic is built on this shift. In the past, the ask‑answer interaction model still had limits on compute and token consumption. Once AI takes over the entire workflow, users only need to approve execution, and the agent can continuously process tasks in the background, potentially causing token usage to grow dramatically.

The "next ChatGPT moment" he refers to is the combination of a sudden drop in entry barriers, improved output quality, and proactive action recommendations. Once users authorize execution, AI usage will expand rapidly. Thus, Grok Bot is not just another efficiency tool but may represent a shift in AI application models.
Building a personal AI work team

Some users suggest starting with a bot named "Chief of Staff" or "CEO," placing it at the top as the single interface for all tasks, then letting it decide how to delegate work to other specialized bots.

Next, users can explain their identity, company business, pain points, the daily tasks they least want to handle, and short‑ and long‑term goals to the main bot. Once this information is entered, they can ask it to suggest which specialized bots to create, plan their roles, responsibilities, and workflows, and directly complete the creation.

Through Grok Bot's cross‑agent scheduling and permission control, the main bot can quickly generate a dedicated AI team with names, avatars, and system prompts. Moving from a single chat window to a continuously operating multi‑agent system is the main reason Baker sees Grok Bot as the next "ChatGPT moment".

items.title: 《彭博》訪談黃仁勳與蔡力行全文！輝達35億美元投資聯發科解讀
paras: 人工智慧（AI）算力需求持續成長，AI晶片市場競爭也從GPU延伸至客製化加速器（XPU／ASIC）。在此背景下，輝達(NVDA-US) 宣布以35億美元可轉換債券投資聯發科(2454-TW) ，雙方將展開長達10年的深度合作，並進一步把輝達的核心互聯、網路及AI基礎設施生態開放給聯發科。
分析指出，這項合作不僅聚焦端側AI與新一代Windows PC，也將延伸至資料中心。聯發科未來可利用輝達的NVLink Fusion等技術，讓其為客戶打造的客製化XPU／ASIC接入輝達AI工廠架構，成為此次合作最受市場關注的部分。
根據雙方規劃，輝達將向聯發科開放多項AI基礎設施技術，包括已發展至第6代的NVLink晶片級互聯技術、Spectrum-X交換器及網路機架架構，以及下一代NVHBM客製化高頻寬記憶體封裝生態。
其中，NVLink Fusion可讓聯發科設計的客製化晶片接入輝達資料中心AI生態。換言之，客戶即使採用聯發科開發的XPU／ASIC，也能搭配輝達的網路、互聯及其他基礎設施。
這項模式也代表輝達的商業策略不再單純圍繞GPU。透過開放網路與基礎設施，輝達希望即使部分AI工作負載由客製化晶片承擔，仍能從資料中心的網路、CPU、交換器及系統架構中持續創造價值。
輝達執行長黃仁勳指出，XPU與ASIC已經存在於市場，且包括雲端服務商在內的客戶對客製化晶片存在需求，因此輝達選擇的方向並非與其直接對抗，而是將這些晶片納入自身的基礎設施生態。
從資料中心價值來看，輝達預估，每GW資料中心的系統價值，已從Hopper時代約180億美元，提升至Grace Blackwell時代約250億美元，而Vera Rubin時代則有望超過400億美元。
背後原因在於AI資料中心已從單純採購GPU，轉變為涵蓋多種晶片、網路交換器及互聯架構的完整AI工廠。輝達因此希望將價值鏈由GPU單一產品，擴展至整套AI基礎設施。
對聯發科而言，與輝達合作則提供進軍雲端AI算力市場的重要切入點。目前聯發科AI晶片業務規模約20億美元，目標明年搶下約800億美元潛在市場的15%，約120億美元。
透過輝達提供的互聯、網路及HBM封裝生態，聯發科可減少ASIC客戶自行建立完整資料中心基礎設施所需的時間與資源。
聯發科董事長蔡力行指出，對ASIC客戶而言，合作的主要價值在於加快產品上市速度，同時保有客製化晶片所帶來的彈性；另一方面，聯發科也能透過輝達的資料中心生態，進一步拓展雲端算力市場。
除了資料中心，雙方合作也延伸至AI PC與端側AI。輝達GPU與聯發科SoC可透過Die-to-Die方式進行封裝互聯，並已推出DGX Spark，主打桌面級AI運算能力，後續也規劃推出面向PC市場的RTX Spark。
雙方另將與微軟(MSFT-US) 合作打造新一代Windows PC，瞄準AI智慧代理（Agentic AI）時代的個人電腦需求。
此外，合作範圍也涵蓋智慧車與機器人等領域，形成雙方在不同AI應用市場互相帶動的合作模式。
供應鏈也是此次合作的重要一環。輝達將下一代客製化HBM技術生態，包括客製化底層基板與CoWoS先進封裝標準，開放給聯發科及其他合作夥伴。
分析指出，其目的在於透過標準化方式整合供應鏈，利用輝達龐大的裝機規模與供應鏈量能，降低AI晶片持續擴張下所面臨的供應限制。
不過，蔡力行也坦言，目前AI基礎設施擴張面臨的最大挑戰仍是供應鏈，包括HBM供應、底層載板產能，以及CoWoS先進封裝產能等，但他仍對未來保持樂觀，並強調台灣處於全球AI基礎設施生態核心圈。
針對輝達投資聯發科後，聯發科又將採用輝達產品是否形成「循環融資」的疑慮，黃仁勳則強調，聯發科本身是全球大型SoC製造商，具備強勁獲利能力，輝達的投資是對台灣科技夥伴及未來10年合作的長期布局，並非透過資金往返形成的財務安排。
至於讓ASIC更容易進入輝達資料中心，是否與黃仁勳此前強調GPU經濟效益優於客製化晶片的說法矛盾，他則認為兩者並不衝突。
GPU具備高度通用性，可涵蓋資料處理、預訓練、後訓練及推理等AI工作；XPU則主要服務特定客戶與特定需求。即使部分GPU工作負載被ASIC取代，輝達仍可透過網路、CPU、交換器與整體AI系統持續創造價值。

輝達、聯發科合作深層戰略意義

分析指出，對輝達而言，此次與聯發科的合作不只是單純的資本投資，更象徵其商業模式進一步從晶片供應商向AI基礎設施平台轉型。
輝達的價值捕捉範圍將從GPU擴大至網路、交換器、CPU、晶片互聯及先進封裝等完整架構，同時透過開放NVLink等核心技術，把原本可能與GPU形成競爭關係的ASIC納入自身生態，將潛在競爭者轉化為合作夥伴，降低正面價格競爭的壓力。
此外，藉由DGX Spark與RTX Spark等產品，輝達也希望提前卡位未來AI智慧代理時代的PC與端側AI市場入口。
對聯發科而言，與輝達合作則有助於突破過去以手機、IoT等端側晶片為主的市場疆界，進一步切入雲端AI算力與資料中心市場。
透過接入輝達已發展至第6代的NVLink技術，聯發科可降低自行建立高速互聯技術的研發投入，並利用輝達既有的AI基礎設施生態，加速客製化ASIC產品商業化。
若再搭配雙方聯合拓展市場的模式，也有望協助聯發科更快接觸雲端服務商等潛在客戶。
從產業格局來看，雙方合作可能進一步推動AI資料中心客製化晶片的標準化。如果NVLink Fusion持續擴大應用，未來可能成為資料中心ASIC接入AI基礎設施的重要技術標準。
與此同時，輝達與聯發科在晶片、互聯、網路及封裝等領域形成更深度的合作，也可能帶動全球AI供應鏈重新整合，進一步凸顯台灣在AI晶片與基礎設施供應鏈中的角色。
另一方面，隨著AI工廠架構日益複雜，競爭也可能從單純的晶片效能，轉向完整生態與系統整合能力。
對規模較小的ASIC業者而言，若缺乏自行建立網路、互聯及先進封裝等完整基礎設施的能力，未來可能面臨更高的市場進入門檻，產業競爭也將逐步從單一晶片競爭走向平台與生態系之間的競爭。

《彭博》輝達CEO黃仁勳與聯發科CEO蔡力行訪談全文

主持人：核心邏輯就是把客戶自己客製的晶片（XPU/ASIC）直接插進任何基於 GPU 的架構裡，共享記憶體和網路。黃仁勳，先請你聊聊，今天宣布的技術協議到底是怎麼回事？
黃仁勳：我們今天宣布了一個重磅合作。其實我們和聯發科合作很久了，但今天要把合作規模做得更大。一開始是因為我們意識到聯發科做出了全球頂級的手機/端側系統級晶片（SoC），於是我們把輝達的 NVLink 晶片級互聯接口整合了進去，這樣聯發科的 SoC 就能直接連上輝達的 GPU。
第一個成果就是 DGX Spark 電腦——這台小電腦算力達到 1 Petaflops，非常強悍，你不用把數據傳到雲端，直接在辦公桌上就能跑先進的 AI 代理（Agentic AI）。
今天我們把合作拓展到了幾個大方向：
1. 多代端側與 PC 晶片：我們會持續合作好幾代處理器，這也將成為我們和微軟共同打造新一代 Windows 個人電腦的基石，為AI 代理時代重塑 PC。
2. AI 工廠與網路互聯：聯發科在做客製化晶片（XPU/ASIC）上非常厲害，我們把 NVLink Fusion 系統、Spectrum-X 交換器以及整套網路機架架構開放給聯發科。這樣聯發科拿下客戶訂單時，就會帶上輝達的網路架構；而聯發科的晶片進入資料中心時，也能無縫接入輝達已有的雲端生態。
3. 機器人與自動駕駛：我們也在智慧車和機器人系統上全面聯手。一句話：他們賣得好，我們能多賣；我們賣得好，他們也能多賣。
聯發科如何向顧客推銷？
主持人：蔡力行，訂製晶片（ASIC）客戶都是自己做加速器，不想重複造輪子。從聯發科的角度來看，拉上輝達的 NVLink 一起，為你們客戶帶來的核心價值是什麼？
蔡力行：非常感謝，也很感謝輝達和黃仁勳對聯發科的信任。從雲端大廠的超算 ASIC、到企業級資料中心，再到桌面級超級電腦，現在的 AI 市場變化極快。聯發科的客製化晶片能力加上輝達的 NVLink Fusion，能讓全端客戶以極高的速度——就像黃仁勳常說的「光速」——去搭建和擴展資料中心，而且靈活度極高。這是我們合作的核心意義。
主持人：你之前說過，聯發科的 AI 晶片業務今年大概 20 億美元，明年目標是拿下 800 億美元潛在市場的 15% 左右。這次和輝達聯手，能幫你加速達成這個目標嗎？
蔡力行：我們當然期待能加速，不過需要一點時間落地。我們正把輝達最新的 NVLink 整合進機架方案裡，它能幫潛在客戶大幅縮短產品上市時間，這在當下是最關鍵的。
主持人：黃仁勳，輝達透過購買可轉債的方式給聯發科投資了 35 億美元，為什麼這麼做？
黃仁勳：這是我們史上最大的合作之一。我們要做多代端側 AI 和 PC 晶片，把輝達 GPU 和聯發科 SoC 做 Die-to-Die 封裝互聯，推出 DGX Spark 和麵向 PC 的 RTX Spark，這是我們對整個 PC 行業的重大承諾。
此外，這也正式確立了雙方在建造「AI 工廠」上的合作。現在的 AI 工廠不只 GPU，還有縱向/橫向擴充交換器、5 種不同網路架構以及 Vera CPU。這次合作讓聯發科的晶片可以直接插進這套完整的 AI 工廠平台。
我和蔡力行認識 25 年了，兩家公司之間有極深的信任。我們簽的是長達十年的路線圖。聯發科本身獲利極佳、業務非常成功，能投資他們是我們的榮幸，我們堅信這筆投資會帶來豐厚回報。
主持人：有人質疑這算不算「循環融資」（投錢給夥伴，對方再買你的產品）？
黃仁勳：這絕對不是循環融資。聯發科有自己的獨立業務，是全球最大的 SoC 製造商，非常賺錢。我們是投資台灣頂尖的科技夥伴，合作著眼於未來十年。這筆投資向市場證明了我們對這個合作的決心和重視。
主持人：蔡力行，聯發科之前發了 50 億美元債券支持供應鏈，這次拿到資金打算怎麼用？在供應鏈上需要更多台灣供應商還是美國供應商？
蔡力行：之前 7 月底還不能公開戰略投資細節。這筆資金用途很廣，供應鏈肯定是其中之一，也是全球佈局的供應鏈。更重要的是，聯發科是一家科技公司，我們會把更多資金砸在核心技術上——提升我們的設計能力、ASIC 製造、連網 IP 以及先進封裝能力。這筆錢會用來加速推進我們和輝達達成的合作協議。
主持人：黃仁勳，你上週在財報電話會上還說 GPU 架構的經濟效益遠超定制晶片，現在 NVLink Fusion 又讓定制晶片（XPU）更容易插進資料中心，這算不算想法改變了？
黃仁勳：XPU 不是將要進入市場，而是早就在市場上了。邏輯很簡單：XPU 是「專用晶片」，而輝達 GPU 是「通用加速器」。我們涵蓋 AI 從資料處理、預訓練、後訓練到推理的全流程，支援全世界所有開源、閉源模型。
因此，輝達 GPU 的通用性、耐用度和可出租性是最高的，能覆蓋任何人都覆蓋不了的市場。但如果客戶（很多也是聯發科和我們的重要夥伴）想在資料中心放一顆專用的 XPU，我們為什麼不讓它更方便地連上輝達的基礎設施呢？
他們做起來更輕鬆，我們也能賣出網路和系統，大家都受益。輝達的市佔率仍在持續成長，我們完全不害怕專用晶片，反而主動開放平台擁抱它們。
主持人：蔡力行，有沒有具體的 ASIC 客戶案例可以分享？他們看到今天的消息會有什麼反應？
蔡力行：我們已經在和一些客戶接觸，實際上是和輝達聯合去拓展市場（Co-GTM）。今天的消息會大大增強客戶的信心，讓他們知道選擇 NVLink Fusion 模式是極為穩健的。 AI 市場非常龐大，有些客戶不需要那麼大的算力，但想要自己的差異化產品，這種模式能幫他們更快把產品做上市，實現三方共贏。
黃仁勳：其實整件事情本來就是客戶主動要求的！很多客戶已經認準了 NVLink Fusion。做 XPU 本身就極難，聯發科能幫他們搞定晶片；但在 AI 工廠裡，還有 5 種網路技術和 CPU 要搞定，輝達的 NVLink 技術已經迭代到第 6 代了，極其複雜。我們把這套能力開放出來，客戶只要提需求，就能一站式搞定整套系統。
主持人：黃仁勳，目前高頻寬記憶體（HBM）價格和供應仍是瓶頸，NVHBM 是什麼邏輯？另外在最新的 Vera Rubin 架構下，輝達在整個伺服器系統的價值佔比是多少？
黃仁勳：以每吉瓦（1 GW）電力的資料中心規模來算：
– Hopper 時代：輝達大約能產生 180 億美元的經濟價值；
– Grace Blackwell 時代：約 250 億美元；
– Vera Rubin 時代：將超過 400 億美元。
為什麼會漲這麼多？因為我們已經不只做 GPU 了，一座 AI 工廠需要用到 7 種不同類型的輝達晶片和多種網路交換器。如果客戶在某些機架上以 XPU 取代了其中一顆晶片，輝達的網路、交換器和 CPU 仍在發揮作用。聯發科加上輝達，能為客戶提供端到端的完整方案。
關於 NVHBM：我們下一代 HBM 是客製化的，HBM 堆疊在輝達定制的底層基板（Base Layer）上，然後必須透過 CoWoS 先進封裝與 XPU/GPU 晶片封裝在一起，這套製程極度複雜。我們把這套 NVHBM 技術和標準開放給了聯發科，也開放給了亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 等首批夥伴。這樣可以把大家的供應鏈整合為統一的標準，大家互相借力龐大的裝機量和供應鏈規模。
主持人：蔡力行，目前聯發科最大的瓶頸是？
蔡力行：主要是供應鏈挑戰，不僅是 HBM，還包括底層載板等。不過台灣處於全球 AI 基礎建設生態的核心圈，這給我們幫了大忙。雖然很難，但我對未來非常樂觀。
黃仁勳：現在輝達的網路生態成為了聯發科供應鏈的一部分，聯發科的 XPU 也成為了我們供應鏈的一部分，雙方透過這次合作共同擴大了供應鏈生態。

items.title: 〈SEMICON〉台積電、AMD齊推新一代水冷板 傳最快明年中量產
items.title_en: SEMICON: TSMC and AMD Unveil Next‑Generation Water‑Cooling Plates, Target Mid‑Year Mass Production Next Year
paras: AI晶片功耗持續攀升，散熱已成為關鍵瓶頸。台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)與超微(AMD-US)今(1)日雙雙揭示下一代水冷技術藍圖，同時釋出將封裝與水冷板整合的技術(TIM less)。業界傳出，包括雙鴻(3324-TW)、奇鋐(3017-TW)、健策(3653-TW)及竑騰(7751-TW)等散熱與設備業者均已參與相關技術開發，新一代水冷板方案最快將於明年中進入量產，大搶新一輪AI液冷升級商機。
AMD今日在談及下一代AI散熱技術時直言，「Thermals is becoming a bottleneck」，釋出Lidless Package技術，透過減少中間的Lid與TIM2，縮短散熱路徑，讓冷卻更有效率，並將Cold Plate Lid、Backside Jet Cooling、Si Micro fluidics等列入未來可能採用的散熱架構。
台積電更直言，為避免AI系統撞上「散熱牆」，最終目標是完全沒有熱介面材料(TIM less)，要讓水冷板直接跟晶片接觸，相較現階段晶片熱能必須依序穿過TIM、Lid、另一層TIM後才能傳導至Cold Plate，未來若能將水冷板直接整合進封裝，可大幅縮短熱傳路徑、降低熱阻，因應下世代數千瓦級AI運算模組的散熱需求。
業界指出，目前TIM less的流程與現階段有所不同，首先會在先進封裝廠依序貼上環形均熱片(Stiffener)與Removable lid，之後再前往系統組裝廠，由組裝廠移除Lid後，再鎖上水冷板，以便銜接後續製程。
業界表示，雙鴻、奇鋐與健策均已切入相關新一代水冷板(Cold Plate)開發，最快明年中旬有機會隨客戶新平台正式進入量產階段，而竑騰則提供前段散熱介質材的貼合製程設備。
paras_en: AI chip power consumption continues to rise, making thermal management a critical bottleneck. Today (1st), TSMC (2330‑TW)(TSM‑US) and AMD (AMD‑US) both revealed their roadmap for next‑generation water‑cooling technology and released a TIM‑less approach that integrates the package with the cold plate. Industry sources say that thermal‑solution firms such as Double‑Hong (3324‑TW), Qihong (3017‑TW), Jiances (3653‑TW) and Hongteng (7751‑TW) are already involved in the development, and the new cold‑plate solution could enter mass production as early as mid‑next year, sparking a fresh wave of AI liquid‑cooling opportunities.

AMD said that “Thermals is becoming a bottleneck” when discussing next‑generation AI cooling, unveiling its Lidless Package technology that removes the intermediate lid and TIM2 to shorten the heat‑flow path and improve cooling efficiency. The company also listed Cold Plate Lid, Backside Jet Cooling and Si Micro‑fluidics as possible future cooling architectures.

TSMC added that to prevent AI systems from hitting a “thermal wall,” its ultimate goal is a completely TIM‑less design that lets the water‑cooling plate contact the chip directly. Currently, chip heat must pass through TIM, a lid, and another TIM layer before reaching the cold plate. Integrating the cold plate into the package would dramatically shorten the thermal path and reduce thermal resistance, meeting the cooling demands of next‑generation multi‑kilowatt AI compute modules.

Industry experts note that the TIM‑less process differs from current methods. First, an advanced packaging fab will sequentially attach a ring‑shaped heat spreader (stiffener) and a removable lid. The assembly then moves to a system‑integration plant, where the lid is removed and the water‑cooling plate is installed, enabling subsequent manufacturing steps.

According to the industry, Double‑Hong, Qihong and Jiances have already entered development of the new cold‑plate (Cold Plate) technology, with the possibility of mass production alongside customers’ new platforms by mid‑next year. Hongteng, meanwhile, supplies equipment for bonding the front‑end thermal interface material.

items.title: 美長債賣壓沉重！30年期殖利率今年有55天站上5% 創2006年來最長紀錄
items.title_en: US Long‑Term Treasury Selling Pressure Heavily Weighted! 30‑Year Yield Stays Above 5% for 55 Days This Year, Longest Since 2006
paras: 美國超長天期公債殖利率已經很久沒有像現在這樣長時間維持高檔，今年來到周一(31日)為止，30年期的殖利率已有55個交易日收在5%以上，為2006年以來最長紀錄，而美國預算赤字、新一波企業發債潮，以及可能成為關鍵轉折的聯準會(Fed)，都讓未來幾周難有下滑的機會。
30年期美債殖利率周二殖利率報5.27%，該殖利率8月中旬一度升至5.34%，創2007年以來最高，距離22年高點僅差10個基點。

殖利率估將繼續上升

即使美國財長貝森特(Scott Bessent)上月宣布擴大買回舊公債，試圖壓低殖利率，但許多投資人仍不認為殖利率會出現持續性的反轉。
財政部的回購行動可能和企業發債潮兩相抵銷，市場預期9月企業債發行規模將達2150億美元，8月企業發債金額已創歷史新高。不僅如此，也很少有人預期美國的財政問題能在短期內消退。
Natixis North America美國利率策略主管John Briggs表示，長天期公債殖利率將維持在高檔，直到赤字格局改變，並直言財政部的買債規模「只是杯水車薪」。
與此同時，Fed 9月會議將考驗主席華許(Kevin Warsh)面對頑強通膨時的升息決心。如果央行對升息有所遲疑，長天期債券預料將遭到進一步拋售。
受華許上周在傑克森洞全球央行年會的鷹派談話影響，交易員預期Fed在9月15-16日會議可能緊縮約17個基點，升息機率接近70%。本周五公布的8月就業數據，以及9月11日將公布的通膨數據，將進一步提供經濟壓力上升程度多大。

「長債時代」走向終結？

從美國到日本，如今各國政府都必須支付更高的利息，才能吸引投資人買進公債、借錢給政府。
由於長天期債券對通膨疑慮更加敏感，如果消費者物價增幅加快，但Fed仍按兵不動，將讓投資人大有理由避開目前已陷入困境的30年期公債。
AmeriVet Securities美國利率交易及策略主管Gregory Faranello說：「如果你希望長天期殖利率下降，就必須升息。」他預期Fed將升息，並看好10年期美債以及期限較短的公債。
不過，也有其他投資人押注美債將進一步走弱。周一的美債選擇權交易顯示，交易員正在押注30年期美債殖利率將升至更高水準，其中一筆交易押注，殖利率將在11月20日合約到期前升至約5.7%。

30年期美債的特殊地位

讓市場更加複雜的是，30年期美債在規模31兆美元的美國公債市場中具有特殊地位。
長天期美債的需求主要來自保險公司與退休基金等投資人，這些機構需要對應延續數十年的負債。相較之下，希望降低投資組合利率敏感度、也就是存續期間的債券經理人，通常會限制長天期債券部位。
美銀(BofA)利率策略師Meghan Swiber與Eleanor Xiao周一寫道：「儘管財政部買債及近期其他政策行動，投資人仍不願增加存續期間曝險。官方部門買盤縮減，使市場愈來愈依賴對價格敏感的私人需求，來消化持續增加的美債供給。」
紐約梅隆銀行(BNY)亞太區總體策略師Wee Khoon Chong也說：「對存續期間與風險資產而言，總體環境正變得更具挑戰性。鷹派貨幣政策、地緣政治與通膨風險再起，加上財政疑慮升高，這些因素正匯聚在一起，持續推升全球期限溢價與長天期殖利率。」

長債已跌深？

但也有一部分投資人開始質疑長債價格還能跌多少，因為30年期美債殖利率已較今年低點上升約65個基點。
Natixis的Briggs表示，他原本看空長天期美債，但在目前水準下，他的看法已「轉為更加中性」。
他說，30年期美債殖利率「仍會緩步走高，但就期限溢價與實質殖利率而言，已經走了很長一段路，不可能永遠以這麼快的速度上升」。
摩根大通資產管理公司(JPMorgan Asset Management)投資組合經理Priya Misra表示，財政部的買債行動可能有助支撐長債需求，但「人工智慧(AI)基礎建設所帶來的龐大供給潮，可能遠遠超過這項支撐」。
她說：「我們可能已接近長天期殖利率的高峰，但考量目前各種交互作用的因素，仍存在不確定性。」

paras_en: The yield on U.S. super‑long‑term Treasury bonds has not stayed at such high levels for a long time. As of Monday (31st), the 30‑year yield has been above 5% for 55 trading days, the longest streak since 2006, and the U.S. budget deficit, a new wave of corporate bond issuances, and the Fed—potentially a key turning point—make a decline in the coming weeks unlikely.
On Tuesday, the 30‑year Treasury yield was 5.27%. It had risen to 5.34% in mid‑August, the highest since 2007, just 10 basis points shy of the 22‑year high.

The yield is expected to keep rising. Even though Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced last month an expansion of Treasury bond buybacks to try to lower yields, many investors still do not expect a sustained reversal.

The Treasury’s buyback program may offset the corporate bond issuance wave; markets expect corporate issuances in September to reach $215 billion, and August corporate issuance already hit a record high. Moreover, few expect the U.S. fiscal problem to ease in the short term.

John Briggs, head of U.S. interest‑rate strategy at Natixis North America, said long‑term Treasury yields will stay high until the deficit structure changes, and called the Treasury’s bond‑buying scale “a drop in the bucket.”

Meanwhile, the Fed’s September meeting will test Chairman Kevin Warsh’s resolve to raise rates amid stubborn inflation. If the central bank hesitates, long‑term bonds are expected to face further selling.

Warsh’s hawkish remarks at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Summit last week led traders to anticipate a tightening of about 17 basis points at the September 15‑16 meeting, with a 70% chance of a rate hike. August employment data released Friday and September 11 inflation data will further gauge the extent of economic pressure.
Is the “long‑bond era” coming to an end? From the U.S. to Japan, governments now have to pay higher interest to attract investors to buy bonds and lend money to the state.

Because long‑term bonds are more sensitive to inflation concerns, if consumer price growth accelerates but the Fed stays idle, investors will have good reason to avoid the already troubled 30‑year bond.

Gregory Faranello, head of U.S. interest‑rate trading and strategy at AmeriVet Securities, said: “If you want long‑term yields to fall, you must raise rates.” He expects the Fed to hike and is bullish on the 10‑year Treasury and shorter‑dated bonds.

However, some investors bet that U.S. bonds will weaken further. Monday’s Treasury option trades show traders betting that the 30‑year yield will rise to about 5.7% by the November 20 contract expiry.
The 30‑year Treasury has a special status in the $31 trillion U.S. Treasury market.

Demand for long‑term Treasuries mainly comes from insurers and pension funds that need to match liabilities lasting decades. In contrast, portfolio managers who want to reduce duration sensitivity typically limit long‑dated positions.

Meghan Swiber and Eleanor Xiao of Bank of America’s rate strategy team wrote on Monday: “Despite Treasury buybacks and recent policy actions, investors still refuse to increase duration exposure. The shrinking official demand makes the market increasingly reliant on price‑sensitive private demand to absorb the growing Treasury supply.”

Wee Khoon Chong, head of overall strategy for Asia‑Pacific at BNY Mellon, said: “For duration and risk assets, the overall environment is becoming more challenging. Hawkish monetary policy, geopolitical and inflation risks resurface, and rising fiscal concerns are converging to keep pushing global term premiums and long‑term yields.”
Has the long bond fallen too far? Some investors question how much further the price can drop, as the 30‑year yield has risen about 65 basis points from its low this year.
Briggs of Natixis said he originally was bearish on long‑dated Treasuries, but at current levels his view has become “more neutral.”
He added that the 30‑year yield will “continue to rise gradually, but in terms of term premium and real yield it has already moved a long way and cannot keep rising at this pace forever.”
Priya Misra, portfolio manager at JPMorgan Asset Management, said Treasury buybacks may support long‑bond demand, but “the massive supply wave from AI infrastructure could far outstrip this support.”
She said: “We may be approaching the peak of long‑term yields, but given the various interacting factors, uncertainty remains.”

paras: 日本財務大臣片山皋月週一(8月31日)表示，她與美國財長貝森特一致認為，兩國近期聯手干預匯市帶來正面效果，但她同時淡化有關貝森特一直敦促日本央行(BOJ)升息的報導。
人在美國北卡羅來納州參加G20財長及央行總裁會議的她說：「貝森特部長和我確認，日元有序波動對維持包括美國市場在內的全球金融市場穩定至關重要，而日美財長共同行動，將有助於實現這一共同目標。」
儘管美日兩國7月底極為罕見地聯手干預匯市，但日元仍面臨新的下行壓力。聯準會(Fed)主席華許上週五發表演說釋放出偏鷹訊號後，日元應聲跌至一個月新低，觸及美日聯手干預以來的最低價位。
日元走弱，加上貝森特近期接連發表暗示日本有必要升息的言論，令市場揣測BOJ可能在9月會議上決定緊縮。
《NHK》週一稍早引述美國財政部負責國際事務的副部長Erin Browne的話報導指出，貝森特在不同的會議上告訴片山和BOJ總裁植田和男，日本下一步行動應該提高利率。
貝森特週一表示，他預計日本政府和日本央行將採取措施推動日元走強，而這一表態暗示BOJ升息的可能性較高。「我掌握一些市場並不知道的資訊，我相信日本政府和BOJ將採取措施，推動日元走強。」
當被問及這是否意味著BOJ將升息時，貝森特答道：「我認為市場現在已經開始消化這一預期。」
貝森特發表上述言論後，日元兌美元走強，進一步強化了市場認為BOJ將在9月會議上升息的預期。
消息人士表示，BOJ最快可能在9月17日至18日舉行的政策會議上升息，且正考慮以快於當前每年大約升息兩次節奏進一步緊縮貨幣政策。
貝森特多次呼籲BOJ升息，已成為推動市場幾乎完全計入9月升息預期的因素之一。BOJ最近一次升息是在今年6月，當時將政策利率上調至1%，創31年來新高。
一些分析師表示，如果BOJ選擇在9月升息而非10月，可能進一步強化市場關於未來每季升息一次的押注。
paras_en: Japan Finance Minister Shigeyuki Katayama said on Monday (August 31) that she and US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen both believe the recent joint intervention in the foreign‑exchange market has had a positive effect, while she downplayed reports that Yellen has been continuously urging the Bank of Japan (BOJ) to raise rates.

Speaking in North Carolina at the G20 finance ministers and central bank governors meeting, she said: "Secretary Yellen and I agreed that an orderly movement of the yen is essential for maintaining stability in global financial markets, including the United States, and that joint US‑Japan actions will help achieve this shared goal."

Even though the United States and Japan carried out a rare joint intervention at the end of July, the yen still faces fresh downward pressure. After Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell delivered a hawkish speech last Friday, the yen fell to a one‑month low, hitting the lowest level since the US‑Japan intervention.
The yen’s weakness, combined with Yellen’s recent remarks suggesting Japan needs to raise rates, has led the market to speculate that the BOJ may decide to tighten at its September meeting.

NHK earlier on Monday quoted Erin Browne, the U.S. Treasury’s deputy assistant secretary for international affairs, reporting that Yellen told Katayama and BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda at separate meetings that Japan’s next step should be to raise interest rates.

Yellen said on Monday that she expects the Japanese government and the BOJ to take steps to strengthen the yen, a statement that implies a higher likelihood of a BOJ rate hike. "I have information that the market does not yet know, and I am confident the Japanese government and the BOJ will act to push the yen higher," she said.
When asked whether this meant the BOJ would raise rates, Yellen replied, "I think the market is already beginning to digest that expectation."
After Yellen’s comments, the yen appreciated against the dollar, further reinforcing market expectations that the BOJ will raise rates at its September meeting.
Sources say the BOJ could raise rates as early as its policy meeting on September 17‑18 and is considering tightening at a pace faster than the current roughly twice‑a‑year rhythm.

Yellen’s repeated calls for a BOJ rate hike have become one of the factors that have led the market to almost fully price in a September hike. The BOJ last raised rates in June, moving the policy rate to 1%, a 31‑year high.
Some analysts note that if the BOJ chooses to hike in September rather than October, it could further strengthen market bets on a quarterly rate‑hike pattern going forward.

items.title: 新興股市創22年來最強8月漲幅！「美元貶值交易」是主要推手 9月面臨Fed升息大考
items.title_en: Emerging Markets Record Strongest August Gains in 22 Years, Driven by "Dollar-Debasement Trade"; September Faces Fed Rate Hike Test
paras: 新興市場股市8月創下2004年以來最大單月漲幅，主因是人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮從大型科技股擴散，加上原物料上漲，帶動資金持續流入開發中國家市場，幫助抵禦了北半球夏季假期期間常見的市場波動。
MSCI新興市場股票指數8月共上漲3.2%，全球投資人尋求分散美元計價資產配置是主因，而這股資金轉向同時也推升黃金需求，現貨金價8月共計大漲了9.7%。
Tellimer新興市場股票與地緣政治策略主管Malik表示，市場押注「美元貶值交易」(dollar-debasement trade)，是支撐新興市場股市上漲的重要力量。美元貶值交易指的是，美國政府可能容許美元購買力逐步下滑，以減輕龐大債務與財政赤字負擔。
Malik說：「美國財政與債務疑慮引發新一輪資金流入新興市場貨幣資產，包括股票。AI科技指標股的市場情緒也趨於穩定，而美元貶值交易則推升黃金價格。」
新興市場股市周一一度面臨壓力。MSCI新興市場股票指數當天下跌0.2%，但已脫離盤中最大1.4%的跌幅，主要是因為中東衝突惡化，以及市場提高聯準會(Fed)9月升息押注。
Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周五在傑克森洞(Jackson Hole)的演說持續發酵，交易員已把9月升息1碼的機率提高至60%以上。
亞洲方面，南韓股市在三星證券指出退休基金進場買進科技股後反彈，由於SK海力士與三星電子周一都上漲上漲至少1.2%，讓MSCI新興市場指數得以收復部分盤中失地。

9月風險事件密集 

隨著時序進入9月，市場將面臨一連串重大事件，包括本周五(9月4日)公布的美國8月非農就業報告，以及9月11日公布的通膨數據，和9月16日Fed利率決策。
若Fed升息，可能削弱「美元貶值交易」的影響力，透過推升美元與美國公債殖利率，進而削弱風險性資產的投資吸引力。

新興市場貨幣連兩月走強

外匯市場方面，新興市場貨幣指數8月是連續第二個月上漲。南韓韓元與南非蘭德是本月表現最佳的新興市場貨幣。
Avenue首席策略師兼合夥人William Castro Alves表示：「投資人尋找美元與美國資產替代選項，正為其他投資標的提供支撐。整體而言，新興市場展望依然正面。」
paras_en: Emerging market equities posted their biggest monthly gain in August since 2004, driven by the AI investment boom spilling over from large‑cap tech stocks and rising commodity prices, which kept capital flowing into developing‑country markets and helped offset the typical volatility during the Northern Hemisphere summer holidays.

The MSCI Emerging Markets Index rose 3.2% in August, as global investors sought to diversify away from dollar‑denominated assets. That shift also boosted gold demand, with spot gold jumping 9.7% over the month.

Tellimer’s emerging‑markets and geopolitical strategy head Malik said the market is betting on a "dollar‑debasement trade," which has been a key driver of the rally in emerging‑market equities. The dollar‑debasement trade refers to the possibility that the U.S. government may allow the dollar’s purchasing power to gradually decline to ease its massive debt and fiscal‑deficit burdens.

Malik added: "Concerns over U.S. fiscal health and debt are prompting a new wave of capital into emerging‑market currency assets, including equities. Sentiment around AI‑related stocks is also stabilising, while the dollar‑debasement trade is lifting gold prices."

Emerging‑market equities faced pressure on Monday, with the MSCI Emerging Markets Index slipping 0.2% that day, though it recovered from an intraday low of 1.4% after the worsening Middle‑East conflict and heightened expectations of a Fed rate hike in September.
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s remarks at Jackson Hole last Friday continued to reverberate, and traders have raised the probability of a one‑point rate hike in September to over 60%.

In Asia, South Korean markets rebounded after Samsung Securities noted that pension funds were buying tech stocks; both SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics rose at least 1.2% on Monday, helping the MSCI Emerging Markets Index recoup some of its intraday losses.

September risk calendar: As the calendar moves into September, markets will face a string of major events, including the U.S. August non‑farm payrolls report on Friday (Sept. 4), inflation data on Sept. 11, and the Fed’s rate decision on Sept. 16.
If the Fed raises rates, it could weaken the impact of the dollar‑debasement trade by pushing up the dollar and U.S. Treasury yields, thereby reducing the appeal of risk assets.

Emerging‑market currencies have strengthened for two consecutive months. In the FX market, the emerging‑market currency index rose for the second month in a row in August, with the South Korean won and South African rand posting the best performances among emerging currencies that month.

William Castro Alves, chief strategist and partner at Avenue, said: "Investors are seeking alternatives to the dollar and U.S. assets, which is providing support to other investment targets. Overall, the outlook for emerging markets remains positive."

items.title: EUR/USD：歐元守在1.16美元附近，美國就業報告將成為本週主要考驗
items.title_en: EUR/USD: Euro Holds Near $1.16, U.S. Jobs Report to Be This Week’s Main Test
paras: 要點：

歐元跌破1.16美元
就業數據將撼動外匯市場
Warsh在傑克遜霍爾釋出謹慎訊號


Warsh在傑克遜霍爾發表偏鷹派談話，重新提振美元。如今，週五公布的非農就業數據將決定這項升息警告是否有經濟數據作為支撐。

歐元迎戰重新強勢的美元


週一，eurusd在1.16美元附近交易，此前美元從上週約1.18美元的位置走強，升至兩週高點附近。
歐元仍有望連續第二個月上漲，但在聯準會主席Kevin Warsh提醒市場美國利率可能需要再次上調後，歐元的上漲動能有所減弱。
Warsh 在傑克遜霍爾表示，除非通膨明確朝聯準會2%的目標靠攏，否則可能需要進一步緊縮。如今，交易員認為9月升息的機率約為57%，大幅高於他發表談話前約35%的水準。
美國2年期國債殖利率升向4.33%，提高美元資產可提供的報酬率。這項殖利率優勢是歐元目前面臨的主要問題：歐元即使有改善中的經濟數據，也必須與一種其央行再次暗示將提高投資人報酬率的貨幣競爭。


週五就業報告將成為關鍵決定因素


8月非農就業數據將於週五美東時間上午8:30公布，經濟學家預期新增約50,000個就業職位，失業率維持在約4.1%。此前7月就業人數意外減少23,000。
如果就業報告表現強勁 — 尤其是非農就業、薪資與工時數據均穩健 — 將支持Warsh的立場，並可能推動歐元進一步跌破1.16美元。
如果就業數據再次疲弱，則可能挑戰市場對9月升息的預期，壓低美國國債殖利率，並為EUR/USD重返近期高點提供更順暢的空間。
交易員應先關注相關的輔助數據。美國 職缺數據將於週二公布，此外，私人部門就業指標、失業救濟金申請人數以及修正後的生產力數據，也將在本週稍後提供更多線索。


歐洲也將公布自己的通膨數據


歐元區通膨數據將於週二公布，整體通膨率可能加速至3.3%附近。較高的通膨將強化市場對歐洲央行9月升息的預期，可能抵銷部分因Warsh言論而獲得支撐的美元漲勢。
最終版製造業與服務業PMI將檢驗歐洲近期的經濟改善是否具有持續性。8月初值調查顯示，受製造業訂單增加與出口重新成長帶動，歐元區企業活動以今年最快的速度擴張。
從技術面來看，1.1600美元是近期關鍵樞軸位，其下方支撐位依序約為1.1550與1.1500美元。上方阻力則位於1.1660 –1.1700美元附近。
如果美國就業報告疲弱、同時歐元區通膨維持強勁，可能迫使EUR/USD向上突破；如果非農就業強勁，則歐元多頭將不得不同時面對聯準會與債券市場的雙重壓力。

paras_en: Warsh’s hawkish remarks at the Jackson Hole forum have revived the dollar, and the non‑farm payroll data released Friday will determine whether this rate‑hike warning is backed by economic evidence.

On Monday, the EUR/USD traded around $1.16 after the dollar strengthened from about $1.18 last week to near a two‑week high. The euro could still rise for a second consecutive month, but its momentum weakened after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh warned that U.S. rates may need to rise again. Warsh said at Jackson Hole that further tightening may be required unless inflation clearly moves toward the Fed’s 2% target. Traders now see about a 57% chance of a September rate hike, up sharply from the roughly 35% level before his speech. The U.S. 2‑year Treasury yield rose to 4.33%, boosting the return on dollar assets. This yield advantage is the euro’s main challenge: even with improving economic data, the euro must compete with a currency whose central bank has again hinted at higher investor returns.

The non‑farm payroll data for August will be released Friday at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time. Economists expect about 50,000 new jobs and an unemployment rate near 4.1%, after July’s unexpected decline of 23,000 jobs. If the jobs report is strong—especially if non‑farm employment, wages, and hours all show solid growth—it will support Warsh’s stance and could push the euro further below $1.16. If the data are weak, it could challenge the market’s September hike expectations, lower U.S. Treasury yields, and provide smoother room for the EUR/USD to return to recent highs. Traders should first focus on related auxiliary data: U.S. job openings will be released on Tuesday, along with private‑sector employment indicators, unemployment‑benefit claims, and revised productivity figures that will offer more clues later this week.

日圓越過危險區域


週一，usdjpy小幅突破160日圓，為最新一次聯合干預以來首次站上此關卡，重新引發市場對東京與華盛頓可能再次出手支撐日圓的猜測。此前該貨幣對一度升至接近164日圓，之後官方買盤介入，將匯率壓低至155.20日圓。
日本在7月30日至8月26日期間投入創紀錄的15.4兆日圓（約965億美元）支撐日圓。美國財政部也參與了此次干預，使這項行動更具可信度。然而僅僅一個月後，這波透過大手筆干預取得的升值幅度大部分已經消失。
近期阻力位落在約160.50日圓，其次為162日圓，以及7月創下的40年高點163.99日圓附近。
支撐位則位於約159日圓，其次為157.50日圓以及干預期間的低點155日圓附近。如果匯率迅速跌破160日圓，將顯示官方警告已經開始影響市場部位。


利差有利美元


聯準會主席Kevin Warsh表示，除非通膨明確朝2%目標靠攏，否則政策制定者「仍有工作要做」。市場將9月美國升息的機率提高至約57%，推動對利率敏感的美國2年期國債殖利率升至約4.33%，創一個月新高。
日本銀行（BOJ）的政策利率目前仍約為1%，使美國短期殖利率高出日本超過3個百分點。
這樣的利差鼓勵利差交易 — 借入低殖利率的日圓，再購買高殖利率的美元資產。在干預行情突然出現、讓原本平靜的交易日瞬間改寫之前，這種策略確實相當有利可圖。
隨著通膨與日圓貶值加劇升息壓力，日本銀行可能在9月會議上升息。然而，日本政府公債殖利率目前也已處於高位，限制政策制定者的操作空間。較高的國內利率可能支撐日圓，但同時也會讓日本龐大的政府債務成本大幅增加。


油價又增添一項麻煩


美國對伊朗拉克島發動攻擊後，伊朗展開對美軍的報復行動，推動 布蘭特原油突破90美元。日本大部分能源仰賴進口，因此油價上漲會增加能源進口支出，進而提高對美元的需求。
儘管美元兌日圓突破160，美國財政部長Scott Bessent仍表示近期市場走勢有序，而且「控制得相當好」。
這降低了近期立即採取聯合干預的可能性。當局通常會針對過度劇烈的波動進行干預，而不只是因為交易員碰到一個在視覺上令人不太舒服的整數關卡。
因此，週五公布的美國非農就業報告將成為下一個重要催化劑。經濟學家預期新增58,000個就業職位，而7月則減少23,000個。
如果就業成長強勁，匯率可能再次朝前期高點靠近；如果就業數據再次疲弱，則可能降低市場對聯準會升息的預期，也等於讓東京不用花錢就完成部分原本需要干預才能達成的效果。

paras_en: Warsh reignites market bets on U.S. rate hikes, oil prices break $90, and the yen has largely retraced gains that were partly due to intervention expectations. The so‑called "red line" that Tokyo has been watching now appears rather fuzzy.

On Monday, the USD/JPY slipped just past 160, the first time it has crossed that level since the latest joint intervention, reigniting speculation that Tokyo and Washington may step in again to support the yen. Earlier the pair had risen to nearly 164 before official buying pushed the rate down to 155.20. Japan injected a record ¥15.4 trillion (about $96.5 billion) between July 30 and August 26 to support the yen, with the U.S. Treasury also involved, lending credibility to the move. A month later, most of the appreciation gained through that massive intervention had disappeared. Recent resistance lies around 160.50, then 162, and the 40‑year high of 163.99 set in July. Support sits near 159, then 157.50, and the low of 155 during the intervention. A rapid break below 160 would signal that official warnings are already influencing market positions.

The Fed’s chair, Kevin Warsh, said that unless inflation clearly moves toward the 2% target, policymakers still have work to do. Markets have pushed the probability of a September U.S. rate hike to about 57%, lifting the yield on the U.S. 2‑year Treasury to roughly 4.33%, a one‑month high. The Bank of Japan’s policy rate remains around 1%, leaving U.S. short‑term yields more than 3 percentage points higher than Japan’s. This spread encourages carry trades—borrowing low‑yield yen to buy higher‑yield U.S. assets. Before the intervention suddenly appeared and turned a calm trading day into a volatile one, this strategy was quite profitable. As inflation and yen depreciation intensify rate‑hike pressure, the BOJ may raise rates at its September meeting. However, Japan’s government bond yields are already high, limiting policymakers’ room to maneuver. Higher domestic rates could support the yen but would also sharply increase the cost of Japan’s massive debt burden.

items.title_en: New York Forex Market: Dollar Weakens as Markets Weigh Fed Rate Outlook
paras: 美元周一(8/31)小幅走低，但仍接近約兩周高點。市場在聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)發表偏鷹談話，以及中東緊張情勢再度升溫後，加碼押注升息。同時，日元在市場密切關注的160日元兌1美元關卡附近徘徊。

華許上周五表示，如果決策官員無法獲得足夠信心，確信通膨正朝2%的目標下降，那麼聯準會「還有工作要做」。這是他迄今最明確的表態，暗示聯準會可能需要進一步緊縮貨幣政策，以抑制價格壓力。

他補充，「華許傳達了一項重要訊號：聯準會並不只依賴金融環境收緊來抑制通膨，如果核心通膨停滯不前，聯準會仍願意進一步收緊政策。」

美元指數仍連續第二個月下跌，因美國財政部本月稍早提出的美國公債回購計畫，再度引發市場對美元貨幣貶值的交易押注。
歐元兌美元上漲0.16%，至1歐元兌1.1602美元。英鎊也小幅走高，至1英鎊兌1.3543美元。兩種貨幣均連續第二個月上漲。
另一方面，波斯灣地區緊張情勢再度升溫，推動油價上漲。市場接下來將關注周一、周二由美國主辦的G20財長與央行總裁會議。投資人將留意各國是否出現協調行動、切斷與伊朗的關係，以及是否會採取措施緩解市場對美國債務增加和公債殖利率上升的擔憂。
持續疲弱的日元同樣受市場關注。日元上漲約0.24%，至159.65日元兌1美元，此前周五曾跌破160日元兌1美元。160關卡普遍被視為可能提高日本官方干預風險的重要水準，也讓市場重新關注東京與華盛頓是否可能再次出手支撐日元。

他指出，「日元仍受到多項壓力，包括利率差距依然很大、實質利率為負，以及日本銀行採取行動的步調仍然謹慎。」

paras_en: The U.S. dollar slipped slightly on Monday (8/31) but remained close to a two‑week high. Markets increased bets on rate hikes after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivered a hawkish speech and Middle East tensions flared again. Meanwhile, the yen hovered near the closely watched 160‑yen‑per‑dollar threshold.
In New York's late session, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, fell 0.29% to 99.41.

Warsh said last Friday that if policymakers cannot gain enough confidence that inflation is moving toward the 2% target, the Fed still has work to do. This is his clearest statement yet, implying that the Fed may need to tighten policy further to curb price pressure.

The remarks lifted expectations of a September rate hike. Market odds that the Fed will raise rates next month have risen to 60%. The 2‑year U.S. Treasury yield, highly sensitive to rates, remains just below a one‑month high.

Rabobank macro strategy head Elwin de Groot said, "Warsh's pre‑planned remarks seem designed to boost market expectations of a rate hike, shift September policy debate back to the hawk side, and restore his credibility in fighting inflation."
He added, "Warsh sent an important signal: the Fed will not rely solely on tightening the financial environment to curb inflation; if core inflation stalls, the Fed is willing to tighten further."

Investors are now focusing on upcoming U.S. economic data, especially the non‑farm payrolls due Friday and next week’s consumer inflation data. Both could influence market expectations for the September Fed meeting.
The dollar index has fallen for a second consecutive month, as the Treasury’s earlier repurchase plan this month sparked renewed dollar‑depreciation bets.
The euro rose 0.16% to 1 euro = 1.1602 dollars. The pound also edged higher to 1 pound = 1.3543 dollars. Both currencies have risen for a second consecutive month.

Meanwhile, Middle East tensions have risen again, pushing oil higher. Markets will next watch the G20 finance ministers and central bank governors meeting hosted by the U.S. on Monday and Tuesday. Investors will look for coordinated action, severing ties with Iran, and measures to ease concerns about U.S. debt growth and Treasury yields.

The persistently weak yen remains a market focus. The yen rose about 0.24% to 159.65 yen per dollar, after falling below 160 yen per dollar on Friday. The 160 threshold is widely seen as a key level that could raise Japan’s official intervention risk, prompting renewed attention to whether Tokyo and Washington might act again to support the yen.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Sunday that the yen’s recent moves are "well‑controlled" and that he expects Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda to make the "right decision" on monetary policy.
UBP Asia senior economist Carlos Casanova said, "Historically, currency market intervention only works when fundamentals move in the same direction."
He noted, "The yen still faces multiple pressures, including a large interest‑rate differential, negative real rates, and the BoJ’s cautious pace of action."

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯齊挫收31.666元 8月仍狂升6.26角
items.title_en: TWD, Stocks and FX Both Slip, Closing at 31.666, August Still Rallied 0.626
paras: 台北股匯今 (31) 日同步走弱，受到熱錢流出影響，新台幣兌美元匯率一度貶破 31.7 元關卡，不過，適逢出口商月底拋匯需求，加上央行出手調節，帶動新台幣貶勢收斂，終場收在 31.666 元，貶值 3.8 分，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 35.505 億美元。
回顧新台幣匯率 8 月表現，全月強升 6.26 角、升幅 1.94%，月線由黑翻紅。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為 31.65 元，盤中最高來到 31.6 元、最低下探 31.732 元。
MSCI 最新季度調整於今天盤後生效，台股今天一度重挫逾 880 點，電子族群普遍賣壓沉重，不過，金融股逆勢撐盤，加上大立光帶動部分共同封裝光學(CPO)概念股走強，指數跌幅逐漸收斂，終場下跌202.98點，收 46128.47 點。台股8月強彈3008.72點，漲幅6.98%，月線收紅。
觀察主要貨幣今天對美元表現，根據央行統計，美元指數上漲 0.31%，新台幣貶值 0.12%，星幣貶值 0.17%，日元小貶 0.04%，而韓元逆勢升值 0.25%，人民幣微升 0.01%，主要亞幣走勢不同調。

However, exporters dumped foreign currency at month‑end and the central bank intervened, curbing the depreciation. The TWD settled at 31.666 per USD, down 0.038, with total FX turnover reaching US$35.505 billion.
